EL MUNDIAL DE LAS APUESTAS: DURANTE EL TORNEO, LOS “MERCADOS DE PREDICCIÓN” MOVILIZARON MÁS DE USD 50 MIL MILLONES Kalshi, Polymarket y Rothera concentraron enormes sumas en operaciones ligadas al torneo, disputando terreno a las casas de juego tradicionales, que también reportaron cifras récord El Mundial 2026 dejó una marca que va más allá del resultado deportivo. De acuerdo con un relevamiento publicado por CoinDesk, las plataformas de mercados de predicción se convirtieron en uno de los protagonistas económicos del torneo, con volúmenes de negociación que rivalizaron e incluso superaron a los de las casas de apuestas deportivas tradicionales en Estados Unidos. Kalshi, una de las plataformas más activas del sector, alcanzó en junio un volumen nominal total de 31.000 millones de dólares, un salto de más del 70% respecto de mayo. Según datos de la firma de análisis Dune citados por el medio, los contratos vinculados al deporte representaron cerca del 85% de esa negociación. La empresa precisó además que el volumen específico asociado al Mundial en su plataforma llegó a 22.420 millones de dólares. El resto del sector también mostró cifras elevadas. Polymarket, el exchange internacional de mercados de predicción, marcó un récord mensual con 10.800 millones de dólares negociados, mientras que su versión regulada para el mercado estadounidense sumó otros 3.500 millones, casi el doble de lo registrado en mayo. A ese panorama se sumó Rothera, la plataforma lanzada en junio por Robinhood y Susquehanna International Group, que en su primer mes de operación procesó 2.000 millones de dólares y ya concentra el 7% del mercado de predicciones en Estados Unidos, según estimaciones de Bank of America difundidas por CoinDesk. 🔗infob.ae/4fc1STk

Flood Victims Receive Just 28 Taka? --- More than 1 million people have been affected by devastating floods. Homes have disappeared under water, families have been displaced, and lives have been lost. Yet, based on the reported relief allocation, it amounts to roughly 28 taka per affected person—an amount that has drawn widespread criticism. For flood survivors, relief isn’t just a number. It’s food, clean water, medicine, shelter, and the chance to rebuild. Disaster response should be judged not by promises, but by how quickly and effectively help reaches those who need it most. An outreach programme on the Income Tax Act, 2025, Income Tax Rules, 2026, and TDS-related issues was organised today at DRDO Bhawan by the Directorate of Management & Security (DMS), DRDO. The programme commenced with an address by Dr. Ravindra Singh, DG (R&M), who highlighted the importance of awareness and compliance with the latest income tax provisions. The technical sessions were delivered by Ms. Beenu, Additional Commissioner of Income Tax; Shri Y. N. Saxena, Deputy Commissioner of Income Tax; and the team from Aaykar Bhawan, New Delhi who provided detailed insights into the provisions of the Income Tax Act, 2025, Income Tax Rules, 2026, and TDS-related issues while addressing participants' queries. The interactive sessions enhanced participants understanding of the new tax framework and strengthened statutory compliance among DDOs and PAOs across DRDO. The programme concluded with a Vote of Thanks by the Director DMS.

Competition between US and Chinese AI models is heating up: The proportion of tokens used by US firms that run through Chinese AI models on OpenRouter is up to a record ~58%. OpenRouter is a platform that allows developers and companies to access and compare AI models from multiple providers, making it a useful gauge of real-world AI model adoption. This percentage has TRIPLED since mid-January, overtaking American peers on the platform for the first time in March. The token share of Chinese models briefly rose as high as 63% in the first week of July. By comparison, Chinese models accounted for less than 10% of usage at the start of 2025, while US models accounted for ~80%. DeepSeek has emerged as the most popular choice among American firms in recent months. Chinese AI models are rapidly gaining market share.

“Hermanos para siempre” 🥹 Antonio Banderas (@antoniobanderas) Hola amigos. Hoy es la final del Campeonato del Mundo de Fútbol. Naturalmente quiero que gane España, pero también el fútbol y todo aquello que une a nuestros dos países. Durante un rato España y Argentina serán rivales. Después volverán a ser lo que siempre han sido para mí: dos pueblos hermanos. Quizá suene tonto decir esto, pero siento la necesidad de expresar que, pase lo que pase, yo seguiré admirando a los inmensos artistas argentinos con los que he tenido el privilegio de trabajar, seguiré admirando a sus jugadores de fútbol y, por supuesto, seguiré queriendo a mis muchos amigos de Argentina y a todo un país al que me siento profundamente unido. El deporte tiene esa maravillosa capacidad de enfrentarnos sin dividirnos, de competir sin dejar de respetarnos y de recordarnos que la verdadera victoria nunca debería pertenecer al odio, sino a la admiración. Que gane quien mejor juegue. Y que, cuando el árbitro señale el final, celebremos todos algo mucho más importante que un resultado: la amistad entre dos países que hablan el mismo idioma, y la oportunidad que nos da la vida para con el buen comportamiento de jugadores e hinchas, de dar ejemplo, de enorgullecer y hacer brillar a las comunidades hispanas de todo el mundo. "The economic effects of illegal migration has been disastrous to poor people in this country." Of course, Alex Karp and anyone who understands economics knows this to be true. Two examples this week. 1. Was talking to a small builder. Was complaining about his backlog because, "A few months ago ICE started picking up my framers and I'm having trouble hiring." I told him about how in the '80s I had friends who, as 16, 17, and 18+ made money in summer working as framers. His response, "They are too few and cost too much." Of course they do: there has not been a demand signal for a long time, and illegal labor undercuts legal labor. 2. This is more personal. A few month ago, we decided that we needed to get the concrete driveway replaced with pavers. Knew a guy and told him we would be ready in June. When we touched base with him, he said, "I can't. ICE took my work crew..." I had no idea he hired illegals. We decided to go with him because he did good work, and bid lower than the other company we got a quote from. With his, "I don't know when I can hire new help..." issue, We called the other company, and as I have done other business with them in the past, originally was backlogged until the fall, but had a cancellation, put us at the top of the list, and will start next week. श्री विवेक अग्रवाल, सचिव, संस्कृति मंत्रालय ने आज राष्ट्रीय पुस्तकालय, बेलवेडियर में भारत के प्रथम ‘शब्द संग्रहालय’ के लोकार्पण समारोह में स्वागत संबोधन के दौरान कहा कि यह संग्रहालय माननीय प्रधानमंत्री श्री @narendramodi के विजन के अनुरूप स्थापित किया गया है। संग्रहालय में ध्वनि से शब्द, शब्द से भाषा और भाषा से लिपि के विकास की यात्रा तथा ब्राह्मी और खरोष्ठी जैसी प्राचीन लिपियों के वैश्विक प्रभाव को प्रदर्शित किया गया है। साथ ही, इस दौरान श्री अग्रवाल ने यह भी जानकारी साझा की कि संस्कृति मंत्रालय द्वारा ‘ज्ञान भारतम मिशन’ के अंतर्गत अब तक 1 करोड़ 18 लाख से अधिक पांडुलिपियों की पहचान की जा चुकी है और उनके डिजिटलीकरण का कार्य जारी है। संस्कृति सचिव ज्ञान भारतम के महत्त्व को रेखांकित करते हुए कहते हैं कि ‘ज्ञान भारतम’ इस संग्रहालय की वास्तविक आत्मा और मूल भावना है। उन्होंने विश्वास व्यक्त किया कि ‘शब्द संग्रहालय’ के प्रथम चरण की यह शुरुआत ‘ज्ञान भारतम’ के माध्यम से भारत की ज्ञान परंपरा को और अधिक प्रभावी ढंग से आगे बढ़ाने में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाएगी। #MuseumOfWord #CultureUnitesAll Video

Dr. Joram Aniya, Member, NITI Aayog, called on Shri Pema Khandu, Chief Minister of Arunachal Pradesh, during her visit to the State to discuss key priorities for sustainable development, and long-term growth. The discussions focused on enhancing disaster preparedness and resilient infrastructure while exploring collaboration in school education, tourism, culture, youth affairs, and sports. Emphasis was laid on integrating disaster risk reduction into development planning and addressing the unique geographical and climatic challenges of the North Eastern States. Dr. Joram Aniya also proposed organising a National Workshop on Sustainable Tourism in Arunachal Pradesh in November 2026 to promote community-based tourism, showcase the State’s rich cultural and natural heritage, and unlock new avenues for sustainable economic growth. स्टार्टअप इंडिया मिशन: सपनों से सफलता तक, भारत की नई उड़ान...🚀🇮🇳 एक समय था जब साल 2014 से पहले देश का युवा सिर्फ नौकरी पाने का सपना देखता था। प्रतिभा थी, विचार थे, लेकिन उन्हें आगे बढ़ाने के लिए न पूंजी थी, न अनुकूल नीतियां और न ही ऐसा माहौल जो उद्यमिता को प्रोत्साहित कर सके। लेकिन साल 2014 में श्री @narendramodi के प्रधानमंत्री बनने के बाद भारत ने एक नई सोच अपनाई— "अब युवा केवल Job Seekers नहीं, बल्कि Job Creators भी बनेंगे।" इसी सोच को साकार करने के लिए 16 जनवरी 2016 को शुरू हुआ स्टार्टअप इंडिया मिशन, जिसने भारत में उद्यमिता की तस्वीर बदल दी। आज की ये उपलब्धियां बताती हैं कि यह बदलाव कितना बड़ा है- ✅ 2.23 लाख+ DPIIT मान्यता प्राप्त स्टार्टअप्स ✅ 23.36 लाख+ प्रत्यक्ष रोजगार का सृजन ✅ 10,000 करोड़ रुपये का Fund of Funds Framework ✅ मजबूत Seed Funding Ecosystem ✅ 1.07 लाख+ स्टार्टअप्स में कम से कम एक महिला निदेशक/साझेदार ✅ Digital India और UPI के माध्यम से मजबूत डिजिटल आधार ✅ भारत दुनिया का तीसरा सबसे बड़ा स्टार्टअप इकोसिस्टम बनने की दिशा में अग्रसर वर्ष 2025-26 भी इस यात्रा का एक महत्वपूर्ण पड़ाव रहा। केवल एक वित्तीय वर्ष में 55,200+ नए स्टार्टअप्स को मान्यता मिली, स्टार्टअप रिकॉग्निशन में 51.6% और प्रत्यक्ष रोजगार में 36.1% की वृद्धि दर्ज की गई। यह केवल आंकड़ों की कहानी नहीं, बल्कि उन लाखों युवाओं की सफलता की कहानी है, जिन्होंने अपने विचारों को उद्यम में बदला, रोजगार के नए अवसर बनाए और भारत को वैश्विक नवाचार के मानचित्र पर नई पहचान दिलाई। आज भारत में स्टार्टअप केवल एक व्यवसाय नहीं, बल्कि आत्मनिर्भर भारत, नवाचार और रोजगार सृजन की मजबूत नींव बन चुके हैं। Video

WSJ: THE SAVE AMERICA ACT BACKFIRE In a floor speech Thursday, North Carolina Sen. Thom Tillis argued that even if Congress whooped through the bill, there isn’t time to implement it before November. By his reckoning, the U.S. has about 10,000 county clerks or municipal entities that carry out America’s decentralized elections. The midterms are barely 100 days away, early voting sooner. “The math doesn’t work,” he said. “It can’t be done.” Mr. Tillis isn’t against ID rules, and he helped pass North Carolina’s. “We should figure out a way to get every state to get to voter ID,” he said. Yet he was unsparing toward Congress’s proponents of the SAVE America Act. “Mr. President, these people are misleading you if they’re telling you that this can be implemented by November,” he said. “This seems like a legit proposal, but it isn’t.” Unfortunately, the message from Mr. Trump and others has been that America’s elections can’t be trusted, and the only hope is the SAVE America Act. Aside from being untrue, this is a political backfire for the GOP. If Republican voters believe it, and the bill falls short, then why waste time going to the polls in November? Has the GOP already forgotten how Mr. Trump’s fraud outbursts cost them two Senate seats in the 2021 Georgia runoffs? wsj.com/opinion/donald-trump…

Sandra Joyce, VP Google Threat Intelligence, spent the past year arguing that disrupting adversary infrastructure has to become normal practice. She’s right. January 2026: Google's threat intel team and partners dismantled IPIDEA, the world's largest residential proxy network. Google counted 550+ distinct threat groups using it, including state actors from China, Russia, North Korea, and Iran. Court orders killed the storefronts and 7,400+ C2 servers went dark. Monday July 13, 2026: The EU and UK rolled out their first-ever joint cyber sanctions package against Russia. Scott Jasper’s study of Russian cyber operations says it bluntly: sanctions and indictments have “done little to alter Moscow’s behavior.” You can't freeze assets that were never here. You can't arrest a GRU officer who never leaves Moscow. Sanctioning at that scale is record-keeping, not deterrence. What will actually degrade an adversary? Joyce's point is that the private sector IS the infrastructure adversaries abuse. Private tech companies own the infrastructure, the platforms, apps, and networks, that these attacks run on, and they can shut an operation down directly and immediately. The most useful thing government can do is to build the legal scaffolding that lets the private sector run these operations at scale. My own proposal is more controversial: a licensed cyber letter of marque system (think bounty hunters for cybercrime) requiring congressional authorization, for limited private-sector offensive operations under strict oversight. If you don’t run a hyperscaler, none of this sounds like yours to act on. It is. For defenders who aren't Google: robtlee73.substack.com/p/san… Tell me where you land on this. And would the letter of marque idea go too far for you? I want the argument.

A glimpse into the world of the 'Museum Of Word,' inaugurated in Kolkata on 19th July 2026 by Hon'ble Minister of Home Affairs & Cooperation Shri @AmitShah. Developed by the Ministry of Culture and situated at the historic Belvedere House within the National Library campus, it is India's first immersive language museum and explores the country's rich linguistic & storytelling traditions. The museum features nine interactive galleries equipped with advanced technologies such as hand-gesture sensors, acoustic hallways, and radio frequency identification (RFID) devices. Adding another literary landmark to Kolkata's rich cultural journey! #MuseumsReimagined #CultureUnitesAll Video

Jordanian authorities have evacuated Aqaba's international airport and seaport, and Americans are being urged to avoid both locations. The alert comes after multiple Iranian missile and drone attacks on Jordan in recent days, including strikes on U.S. military facilities, as well as Iranian warnings that countries supporting U.S. military operations could face additional attacks. U.S. Embassy Amman (@USEmbassyJordan) Security Alert: U.S. Embassy Amman - July 19. 2026 Due to a specific and credible threat, Jordanian authorities evacuated the international airport and seaport in Aqaba. We strongly advise all Americans to refrain traveling to either the airport or seaport. Continue to follow all Jordanian authorities’ security directives. U.S. Embassy Amman continues to advise all Americans to avoid travel to military bases in Jordan. On March 2, 2026, the Department of State ordered non-emergency U.S. government employees and their family members to leave Jordan due to safety risks. Actions to Take: Please visit Jordan’s National Center for Security and Crisis Management website for public safety guidelines, including explanations of emergency sirens in Jordan. Avoid all demonstrations and large gatherings. Avoid all areas where there is a heavy police presence. Monitor local media. Follow the instructions of local authorities. Contact your airline directly for flight change details if your flight is affected. Exercise caution and stay alert at locations publicly associated with the United States. Keep a low profile. Enroll in the Department of State’s Smart Traveler Enrollment Program (STEP). STEP enrollment connects you to the U.S. embassy or consulate so you get the latest security updates. It also makes it easier for the U.S. Embassy or consulate to contact you in an emergency. I am deeply saddened by the passing of Ambassador Carmen Moreno Toscano, a pioneering Mexican diplomat and a steadfast advocate for human rights and the advancement of women. Ambassador Moreno made an enduring contribution to the Organization of American States, first representing Mexico before the Organization and later serving for a decade as Executive Secretary of the Inter-American Commission of Women @CIMOEA. I had the pleasure and honor of working alongside her during some of those years. Through her leadership, she helped strengthen the inter-American agenda for women’s rights, political participation, equality, and the prevention and eradication of violence against women, including through the implementation of the Convention of Belém do Pará. Her wisdom, diplomatic skill, and lifelong commitment to public service earned her the respect and admiration of colleagues throughout the Americas. Her legacy will continue to inspire those working to build a more equal, just, and peaceful hemisphere. I extend my heartfelt condolences to her family, friends, former colleagues, and to the Government and people of #Mexico. When it comes to protecting the lives and livelihoods of our people, there is no Government or Opposition only Sri Lanka. Today, at the National Council for Disaster Management chaired by H.E the President, I shared a strategic science-backed proposal to help Sri Lanka prepare for the anticipated climate risks of 2026–27. My message was simple; we cannot afford to wait for disaster to strike we must act. By strengthening early warning systems, safeguarding our food and water security, and planning together as a nation, we can create greater resilience against climate change. NewsWire 🇱🇰 (@NewsWireLK) Opposition Leader Sajith Premadasa has proposed a series of measures to strengthen Sri Lanka’s climate resilience and disaster preparedness, warning that the country should act now to prepare for the anticipated impacts of the 2026-2027 El Niño cycle. Speaking at the National Council for Disaster Management, chaired by President Anura Kumara Dissanayake, Premadasa said climate security has become a national priority that requires a united, science-based response beyond political differences. Citing global scientific assessments, Premadasa warned that the developing El Niño could be among the strongest in recent decades, bringing prolonged droughts followed by severe flooding. He said Sri Lanka should move away from responding to disasters after they occur and instead adopt an anticipatory governance model based on scientific forecasting, risk assessments and early preparedness. Among his key proposals was making climate resilience a whole-of-government responsibility involving institutions responsible for agriculture, water resources, energy, health, finance, defence, provincial administration and local government. Premadasa also called for integrated reservoir management to improve water security, expansion of climate-smart agriculture to strengthen food security, and the modernisation of early warning systems through impact-based forecasting that provides communities with more actionable information before disasters strike. He further proposed strengthening disaster risk financing, improving preparedness for heatwaves and public health emergencies, enhancing the resilience of critical infrastructure, and establishing a National Climate Risk and Disaster Intelligence Centre to support evidence-based decision-making across Government. Premadasa said Sri Lanka should also draw lessons from countries such as India and Australia, which have strengthened climate forecasting, agricultural contingency planning and broader resilience initiatives in response to growing climate risks. Looking beyond the immediate El Niño threat, he proposed the preparation of a Presidential White Paper on National Climate Resilience and Disaster Preparedness to establish a long-term policy framework that would guide future governments. He stressed that climate resilience cannot be achieved by the Government alone and requires the participation of Parliament, provincial and local authorities, the scientific community, universities, the private sector, civil society, international development partners and local communities. Premadasa added that protecting the lives and livelihoods of Sri Lankans must remain a shared national responsibility. رسانه‌های پاکستانی گزارش داده‌اند که تجارت ترانزیت افغانستان و پاکستان در سال مالی ۲۰۲۶ پاکستان، به پایین‌ترین سطح خود رسیده و ارزش آن تنها ۳۶۷میلیون دالر بوده است. بر بنیاد این گزارش، ارزش تجارت ترانزیت میان دو کشور پیش از سال ۲۰۲۱ به حدود پنج میلیارد دالر می‌رسید و سالانه نزدیک به ۸۹هزار کانتینر میان دو کشور جابه‌جا می‌شد؛ اما این رقم در سال جاری به حدود ۱۱ هزار و ۶۰۰ کانتینر کاهش یافته است. بر پایه گزارش، تجارت ترانزیت میان افغانستان و پاکستان در سال ۲۰۲۳ از وضعیت مطلوبی برخوردار بود؛ به‌گونه‌ای که شمار کانتینرها از ۱۰۲ هزار فراتر رفت و ارزش آن ۶.۷ میلیارد دالر گزارش شد. در این گزارش آمده است که روی‌آوردن افغانستان به ایران به‌عنوان مسیر بدیل و نیز مسدود ماندن گذرگاه‌ها میان کابل و اسلام‌آباد، از عوامل اصلی این کاهش به شمار می‌روند. این گزارش همچنین می‌افزاید که افغانستان حتی پیش از بسته‌شدن گذرگاه‌ها نیز تجارت ترانزیت خود با پاکستان را کاهش داده و در پی گسترش همکاری‌های ترانزیتی و تجاری با ایران و کشورهای آسیای مرکزی بوده است. #طلوع‌نیوز

Efekt? Zniszczona infrastruktura odbudowana z plusem - w lepszej jakości bądź z nowymi funkcjonalnościami. Podsumowanie realnego wsparcia: 💸 ⁠Ponad 1 mld zł trafił bezpośrednio do 62 tys. rodzin - zasiłki z rezerwy MSWiA pozwoliły ludziom skutecznie odbudować domy i pomieszczenia gospodarcze. 💸 Samorządy sprawnie zamknęły bądź jeszcze realizują inwestycje – od dokumentacji, przez przetargi, aż po odbiór infrastruktury. Drogi, mosty i budynki użyteczności publicznej znów służą mieszkańcom. 💸 Fundusze unijne zostały w 100 proc. wykorzystane tam, gdzie były najbardziej potrzebne. Rządowa pomoc zadziałała szybko i skutecznie. Odbudowa po powodzi 2024 staje się faktem.

These assumptions matter because Iran is often viewed through the same flawed lens. Deputy Prime Minister/Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar @MIshaqDar50 received a call from the newly appointed Minister of Foreign Relations and Foreign Trade of the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela, H.E. Félix Plasencia. DPM/FM extended his warm congratulations to Minister Plasencia on his appointment. He conveyed Pakistan’s heartfelt condolences over the devastating earthquakes that recently struck Venezuela. He reaffirmed Pakistan’s unwavering solidarity with the Government and the people of Venezuela during this difficult time and expressed confidence in their resilience and recovery. Minister Plasencia thanked DPM/FM for Pakistan’s message of sympathy and solidarity. He also expressed appreciation for Pakistan’s support and humanitarian solidarity with the victims of the natural disasters, underscoring the importance of mutual support in times of need. He further acknowledged Pakistan’s constructive role in promoting dialogue and de-escalation in the regional situation involving the United States and Iran and commended its commitment to peace and diplomacy. The two Ministers exchanged views on the longstanding friendly relations between Pakistan and Venezuela and reaffirmed their shared commitment to further strengthening bilateral ties. They discussed opportunities to expand cooperation across a broad range of sectors, including trade, investment, business, agriculture, IT, and other areas of mutual interest. Both sides underscored the considerable potential for enhancing economic collaboration and fostering stronger people-to-people contacts for the mutual benefit of the two countries. DPM/FM emphasized the importance of sustained high-level engagement to reinvigorate bilateral relations and further deepen cooperation. Both sides appreciated the continued close coordination between Pakistan and Venezuela at multilateral forums on issues of common interest. They agreed to remain in close contact and to meet at the earliest appropriate opportunity. @Cancilleria_ve

Deputy Prime Minister/Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar @MIshaqDar50 held a meeting with Foreign Secretary Ambassador Amna Baloch and senior officials of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and discussed recent diplomatic engagements. Deputy Prime Minister/Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar @MIshaqDar50 received a telephone call today from the Foreign Minister of the State of Kuwait, H.E. Sheikh Jarrah Jaber Al-Ahmad Al-Sabah. The two Foreign Ministers discussed the latest developments in the region. Foreign Minister Sheikh Jarrah shared Kuwait’s serious concerns regarding the continued attacks on its territory and expressed hope that restraint would be exercised by all sides and that the Islamabad MoU would be fully implemented. Foreign Minister Sheikh Jarrah also appreciated Pakistan’s constructive and mediatory role in promoting dialogue and regional stability. The Deputy Prime Minister/Foreign Minister underscored the urgent need for de-escalation, stressed the importance of respecting the sovereignty and territorial integrity of all states, and emphasized that maintaining regional peace and security must remain the foremost priority. He also underlined the importance of upholding ceasefire commitments under the Islamabad MoU and avoiding any actions that could further escalate tensions. The two leaders agreed to remain in close contact on matters of mutual interest. @MOFAKuwait

⁨⁨Mirzaganj Witnesses Alleged Political Violence: Awami League Leader’s Family Home Demolished as Authorities Accused of Inaction --- The events reported in Mirzaganj, Patuakhali, have raised serious concerns about political violence and the treatment of opposition figures in Bangladesh. According to the allegations, the ancestral home of Kazi Mizanur Rahman Lovlu, President of Ward No. 1 Madhabkhali Union Awami League and the current Union Chairman, was subjected to a coordinated attack that resulted in its complete destruction. The incident has been described by the victims as an act of organized violence and looting rather than a political dispute. Before the attack, the victim’s relative, Kazi Mashiur Rahman Bablul, appealed through a Facebook Live broadcast to the public, the administration, and even BNP leaders, urging them to prevent the violence. Although members of the administration reportedly arrived at the scene, they allegedly left without taking action. According to the account, the attack began shortly after the authorities departed. The attackers allegedly used a heavy excavator during the night to demolish the entire house, reducing it to rubble. The victims describe the demolition as deliberate and systematic, claiming the house was intentionally destroyed over the course of the night. According to the allegations, the attack was carried out under the direct instruction of former Home Minister and BNP leader Altaf Hossain Chowdhury. His brother Shahin Chowdhury, along with Palash Halder, Monir Khandakar, Sumon Talukdar Tunu, and Mohasin Member, are accused of leading the operation. The victims further allege that Miraj, a candidate for the Chhatra Dal presidency, personally supervised the removal of household belongings, with five vans reportedly transporting valuables, including refrigerators and furniture. They also claim that the attackers broke open wardrobes and looted approximately 17 bhori of gold jewelry, along with important family documents and other valuables. After the looting, the remaining structure was allegedly set on fire. The victims argue that the incident represents a grave example of politically motivated violence carried out under the cover of administrative inaction. They question who will be held accountable for the alleged demolition, looting, and arson that destroyed their ancestral home.⁩ #Bangladesh #BNPViolence #AwamiLeague

⁨257 Deaths in Custody Since August 2024 — A Sister Fears Her Brother Could Be Next - DW Bangla Report p.dw.com/p/5HIhe --- Since August 2024, a total of 257 people have died in security custody. Of them, 30 died in police custody and 227 died in prison custody, according to the human rights organization Manabadhikar Sangskritik Foundation (MSF). According to the organization, 43 leaders and activists of Awami League have died in police and prison custody during this period. Of these, 3 died between 5 August and December 2024, 24 died in 2025, and 17 died during the first six months of 2026. Sister Fears for Her Brother’s Life Azme Ara Begum, the sister of Rajshahi Metropolitan Awami League General Secretary W (Dablu) Sarkar, fears that her brother could die while in security custody. Dablu Sarkar was arrested on 4 October 2024. Since then, 23 cases, including murder charges, have been filed against him. He has spent a total of 70 days on remand. After being transferred repeatedly between prisons, he is now being held at Kashimpur Prison. Over the past two years, he has not been granted bail in any of the cases filed against him. At the same time, none of those cases has reached a conclusion in court. His family alleges that he has been subjected to repeated torture both in prison and during remand following his arrest. They say he has fallen seriously ill several times while in custody. Family members have reportedly been given very limited access to visit him, and requests for treatment at a hospital outside the prison have not been approved. His sister, Azme Ara Begum, said, “Our family members are hardly allowed to see him. Earlier, he was allowed to speak with us by telephone from prison, but that opportunity has now been taken away. Besides the torture, he is now suffering from multiple illnesses. His health has deteriorated significantly. He is not receiving adequate medical treatment in prison. We fear that he may die in prison without proper medical care.”⁩ #CustodialDeath #Bangladesh #AwamiLeague

Presented as a step toward socialism and financial inclusion, the decision fundamentally altered India's banking system. With nearly 85% of the country's banking deposits brought under government control, lending increasingly became vulnerable to political influence. Commercial banking gradually gave way to politically directed credit, where loans were often sanctioned to fulfil populist objectives rather than sound financial assessment. This marked the beginning of the "loan mela" culture, weakening credit discipline and institutional autonomy. Over the following decades, politically motivated lending, inadequate risk evaluation, and poor recovery mechanisms contributed to the build-up of massive Non-Performing Assets (NPAs), burdening public sector banks and ultimately costing taxpayers dearly. I can confirm that throughout 2023–2024 we suffered enormous losses because of repeated counterattacks to retake tree lines and ruins, and it all followed the same pattern. Our troops occupied advantageous positions and destroyed the enemy as if at a shooting range. Enemy losses were 17–25 times greater than ours. But then "someone" decided the line on the map wasn't neat enough, and the endless orders began: "straighten the line," "retake the previously lost positions." The result was losses that were impossible to justify, with two consequences. First, the casualty ratio dropped to only three to one. Second, our infantry was often too small in number and disoriented, allowing the enemy to break through not only the "retaken positions" but also the previously stable defensive line where they had earlier failed again and again despite enormous losses. This is how we lost an enormous number of people—so many that, had they been preserved, there would have been far less need for new mobilization. The second recurring pattern was the rotations in 2023–2024. During these rotations, the enemy struck newly arrived units and broke through. These constant rotations to patch holes elsewhere, with breakthroughs as the inevitable consequence, were also characteristic of Syrskyi's style. Any other army in the same situation would have assigned sectors of responsibility to large formations—divisions, corps, armies—and reinforced them with fresh battalions. Instead, we saw the constant creation of new units and endless crisis micromanagement instead of an overall strategy. By 2025–2026, this entire Syrskyi-style way of fighting had become impossible because of drones. Yet attempts to continue fighting this way have not stopped. Fighting through unjustified losses and constant micromanagement without sustained support has simply become a habit. If earlier this approach cost us Ocheretyne, now it is Siversk. The strategy remains the same: weaken our own forces and allow the enemy to gain the advantage. Anyone would have replaced General Syrskyi long ago with someone more capable. Anyone would also have sought the advice of a trusted military adviser instead of reacting emotionally and trying to command military professionals directly. At the end of 1942, Stalin recognized the brilliance of General Antonov, whose phenomenal memory impressed him, and made him his principal adviser. It was precisely because Stalin listened to Antonov that the victories which followed became possible. Antonov also had the courage to tell Stalin the truth in private, although after the war Stalin's pride resurfaced, and he sent Antonov away to the provinces in 1948. Churchill and Roosevelt tested generals and replaced them until they found commanders who did not merely fight, but who won. Once they found winners, they tolerated them despite all their eccentricities. Today, in the era of drone warfare, we objectively need a different kind of war than the one fought under Syrskyi and Zelenskyy in previous years. We need a different team of generals capable of winning the war that is being fought today, because Syrskyi's methods lead toward defeat once the enemy completes its mobilization. And we must have the patience to trust new generals instead of interfering with their command. Biden Appointee’s Impressive En Banc Ruling on Second Amendment and ‘Assault Firearms’ Yesterday the en banc Third Circuit ruled (in Association of New Jersey Rifle and Pistol Clubs v. Attorney General) that New Jersey’s ban on so-called “assault firearms” and its restrictions on possession of “large capacity ammunition magazines” (LCMs) violate the Second Amendment. Judge Arianna J. Freeman, appointed by Joe Biden in 2022, wrote the impressive majority opinion for eight judges. (Or perhaps I should say for ten judges, since a ninth states that she “fully support[s] the majority opinion” and a tenth that he joins the majority opinion “in nearly every respect.”) Five judges dissented. I am not going to summarize the 192 pages of opinions here. I’ll make just a few observations: 1. In addition to composing a powerful 60-page opinion, Judge Freeman demonstrated real courage in departing from the Left’s tenaciously held party line against Second Amendment rights. She could easily have voted to defer ruling on the matter on the ground that the issue will be decided by the Supreme Court next term (in the consolidated cases of Viramontes v. Cook County and Grant v. Higgins). But she refused to take that path. Freeman also might have gone no further than to affirm the district court’s ruling that New Jersey’s ban on Colt AR-45s violates the Second Amendment. But she instead determined that “the record supports the same result for all semi-automatic rifles,” so she broadened the district court’s order to cover all semi-automatic rifles covered by the New Jersey ban. In concluding that the LCM restrictions violate the Second Amendment, she also rejected the district court’s conclusion. As a young (47 or 48 years old) African American appellate judge with a Yale law school pedigree, Freeman has been touted as a strong candidate for a Supreme Court nomination by the next Democrat president. As Freeman surely knew, her ruling has destroyed her chances of ever being nominated to the Court. The Left is livid over the ruling, and its anger is intensified by Freeman’s lead role in it. According to New Jersey attorney general Jennifer Davenport, who called the ruling “as unfortunate as it is legally incorrect,” “every other federal circuit court to consider the issue has come out the other way.” Any effort to depict the Second Amendment argument against bans on “assault firearms” as extreme is severely undercut not just by Freeman’s opinion but by who she is. High blood pressure - or #hypertension - often shows no warning signs, yet it increases the risk for heart disease, stroke, blindness, dementia, and other complications. A simple blood pressure check can be life-saving. Getting your blood pressure measured the right way helps ensure accurate results. Incorrect positions can lead to incorrect readings. ✔ Sit with your back supported ✔ Legs uncrossed and feet flat on the floor ✔ Arm supported with the cuff at heart level ✔ Use correct cuff size ✔ Rest for at least 5 minutes before the reading ✔ Do not talk during or between measurements ✔ Avoid exercise, tea/coffee, and smoking for at least 30 minutes before reading Small steps can make a big difference in protecting your health.

Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif’s Message on the Occasion of Youm-e-Ilhaq-e-Pakistan (Kashmir’s Accession to Pakistan Day) 19 July 2026. Youm-e-Ilhaq-e-Pakistan (Kashmir’s Accession to Pakistan Day) is observed annually to commemorate the historic resolution adopted by the All Jammu and Kashmir Muslim Conference at its Srinagar session on 19 July 1947. The unanimous resolution reflected the collective political aspirations of the Muslims of Jammu and Kashmir at a defining moment in the history of the subcontinent. It expressed their desire for the State’s accession to Pakistan and called upon the Dogra rulers to respect the will of the people. The resolution remains an important historical milestone in the political struggle of the people of Jammu and Kashmir. This occasion also serves as a reminder of the enduring bonds that unite the peoples of Pakistan and Jammu and Kashmir, founded on shared history, faith, culture, geography and longstanding ties. Above all, it underscores the central importance of respecting the freely expressed will of the Kashmiri people. Pakistan remains steadfast in its principled support for the inalienable right to self-determination of the people of Jammu and Kashmir, as enshrined in the relevant United Nations Security Council resolutions. The unresolved Jammu and Kashmir dispute continues to have profound implications for regional peace and security. Lasting peace in South Asia requires its peaceful resolution in accordance with the relevant United Nations Security Council resolutions and the aspirations of the Kashmiri people. The Government and people of Pakistan salute the courage, resilience and steadfastness of the people of Indian Illegally Occupied Jammu and Kashmir (IIOJK) in their just struggle for the realization of their fundamental rights. Luton, UK: Shaykh-ul-Islam Dr Muhammad Tahir-ul-Qadri Delivers Keynote Address at "Shan-e-Ahl-e-Bait-e-Nabvi ﷺ Conference" His Eminence Shaykh-ul-Islam Dr Muhammad Tahir-ul-Qadri, founding leader of Minhaj-ul-Quran International, delivered the keynote address at the "Shan-e-Ahl-e-Bait-e-Nabviﷺ Conference", organised on the occasion of the "Ta'ziyati Reference of Pir Syed Abdul Qadir Shah Jillani (R.A)" under the auspices of Markazi Jama'at-e-Ahle Sunnat (UK & Overseas) at Jamia Islamia Ghousia Trust, Luton. Addressing a large gathering of scholars, community leaders and students of knowledge, Shaykh-ul-Islam delivered a profound Qur’anic exposition of Ayat al-Tatheer (The Verse of Purification) from Surah al-Ahzab (33:33): اِنَّمَا یُرِیْدُ اللهُ لِیُذْهِبَ عَنْکُمُ الرِّجْسَ اَهْلَ الْبَیْتِ وَیُطَہِّرَکُمْ تَطْہِیْرًا “Stay in your homes and do not display your charm, like the displaying of the former (days of) ignorance. Establish the prayer, pay the alms due and keep obeying Allah and His Messenger (ﷺ). Indeed, Allah only desires to keep all (forms and causes of) impurity away from you, O Members of the (Prophet’s) Family, and purify you with a thorough purifying.” Shaykh-ul-Islam explained that this blessed verse is a clear and unequivocal declaration of the unique rank, spiritual excellence and divinely bestowed purity of the blessed Ahl al-Bayt (ʿalayhim al-salām). He stated that Almighty Allah Himself has declared His exclusive will to remove every form of rijs—including every impurity, spiritual defect, doubt, moral corruption and anything contrary to goodness—and to grant them complete and perfect taṭhīr. Explaining the Qur’anic language, Shaykh-ul-Islam emphasised that the verse is not merely a command for the Ahl al-Bayt to attain purity through their own efforts. Rather, it is a decisive declaration that Allah ﷻ Himself undertook their complete purification. This divine act establishes their honour, purity and spiritual rank through the Qur’an itself. He further explained that the emphatic expression “وَيُطَهِّرَكُمْ تَطْهِيرًا” signifies not an ordinary form of purification but a complete, perfect and divinely bestowed purification encompassing every aspect of their belief, intentions, character, conduct, sacrifice and spiritual excellence. He stressed that the sacrifices of the Ahl al-Bayt, particularly the events of Karbala, must be understood through this Qur’anic declaration rather than through political or worldly interpretations. Elaborating on the unparalleled virtues and elevated status of the Ahl al-Bayt in the light of the Holy Qur’an and authentic Prophetic traditions, Shaykh-ul-Islam affirmed that love, reverence and loyalty to the Ahl al-Bayt are fundamental to the creed of Ahl al-Sunnah. He urged believers to return to the Qur’an and Sunnah when understanding their status and warned against allowing polemics or distorted historical narratives to shape their perception. He described the blessed Household of the Holy Prophet ﷺ as the purest embodiment of his guidance, character and spiritual legacy, whose lives continue to illuminate the path of faith, knowledge, piety and moral excellence. The conference was attended by Pir Syed Mazhar Hussain Gillani, President of Markazi Jama’at-e-Ahle Sunnat (UK & Overseas); Pir Syed Munawar Hussain Shah Jamati; Syed Ali Abbas Bukhari, President of Minhaj-ul-Quran International UK; Allama Qazi Abdul Aziz Chishti MBE, Secretary General of Markazi Jama’at-e-Ahle Sunnat (UK & Overseas); alongside distinguished scholars, community leaders and members of the Muslim community from across the United Kingdom. The gathering concluded with collective prayers for the unity of the Muslim Ummah and for peace, stability and prosperity throughout the world. #AhlulBayt #ProphetMuhammad #ShaykhUlIslam #DrTahirulQadri #Luton #IslamicEvent #UKMuslims #MarkaziJamaatEAhleSunnat #LoveForAhlulBayt #MQIUK

I'm genuinely confused by the argument here. It seems to be: open-weight AI models reduce the profits of American VC-backed companies; many leading open models currently come from China; therefore open AI is somehow "communist." We've never applied that logic to any other technology. Linux, Apache, PostgreSQL, and countless other open-source projects destroyed proprietary software margins and dramatically reduced returns for some investors. We called that competition and innovation—not communism. If the concern is reliance on Chinese AI, make that argument. If the concern is national security, make that argument. But "this technology makes it harder for incumbents to earn monopoly-like returns" has never been a definition of communism. It's often just what technological progress and real free markets look like. Dean W. Ball (@deanwball) Some observations on Kimi: 1. It's a very good model! I don't think its performance can be explained away by distillation or anything like that. In agentic coding sessions, it seems pretty much on par with the best public models of Q1 2026. In my fairly limited use, it also seemed very token hungry. It's not obvious to me that this model is actually that cheap to run. 2. I am personally surprised the Chinese state continues to allow the open sourcing of models this good, given potential risks. To be clear, I *myself* might be fine with models presenting this level of marginal risk being open weight, but I am surprised that China is fine with it. I suspect the reason they are is 75% explained by strategic blindness/lack of AGI-pilledness (the CCP is very Yann Lecun-y in its views of AI). The other 25% or so is their lack of compute for customer inference (making China's open-weight strategy an unintended byproduct of US export controls) and the normal Chinese strategy of aggressive exports. For the companies, as opposed to the government, the decision to open source is partially ideological and partially because they are behind, and they know that very few people would pay for sub-frontier models from China. 3. Open-weight models are inherently decelerationist, and I'm continually surprised to see the so-called "accelerationists" so excited about open-weight models. I suspect the reason they are is that they know open-weight models are effectively ungovernable, and they simply like the overall cloak of ungovernability open-weight models create over the whole of AI. It's not a bad strategy; it reminds me of James Scott's recounting of the hill people in "the art of not being governed." Still, in the end, open-weight models deter further AI capex. 4. One probable outcome of an open-weight-model-dominant world is full AI communism, which is precisely what China proposes: rather than a market product, AI is a "public good" which will ultimately be provided by the state as a kind of "digital public infrastructure." This future strikes me as a dystopian hellscape, but I've never met an open-weight models advocate who doesn't ultimately concede this is where things end. You'd be surprised how many 'accelerationists' lobbied me, while I was in government, to support an eleven or twelve-figure federally funded data center so that startups could train models at a subsidy and then give them away for free. There was no other way for AI to progress, they said. Perhaps this is the logical end state of things. Nonetheless, I find myself surprised to see supposed accelerationists excited about such an outcome. I think many of them just don't know what they're doing. Many accelerationists do not view the creation and serving of frontier models as a legitimate business. 5. I would guess that the Trump Administration will at some point realize that their best strategy here would be to create large amounts of regulatory risk around the use of open-weight Chinese models. You don't need to "ban open source" (one of the dumber motifs of AI policy discussion). You just need to direct every agency to issue soft law that creates FUD. "A Federal Reserve Advisory Bulletin found that there may be backdoors in Chinese AI models." It needn't be that well justified. You just create enough regulatory risk that every regulated enterprise backs off. You probably don't want to create so much regulatory risk that you scare off the hyperscalers from serving Chinese models; this will just drive startups to sketchier providers. There's a happy middle ground here. I'd assume they will do some version of this. 6. It's probably true that open-weight models of this capability make the world a bit more dangerous, but not so much more that you'll really notice. At some point the models will be capable enough that you will notice. "A nonliving, invisible, dangerous, and infinitely self-replicating agent escaped from a Chinese lab," you say? Color me shocked. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/deanwball/status/2078133895766114412#m

आज पश्चिम बंगाल के सिलीगुड़ी में भारत-बांग्लादेश सीमा से जुड़े सुरक्षा मुद्दों पर बैठक की। मोदी सरकार सीमावर्ती क्षेत्रों में मादक पदार्थों की तस्करी, आर्थिक अपराध और घुसपैठ के खिलाफ ज़ीरो टॉलरेंस की नीति के तहत आगे बढ़ रही है। अब पश्चिम बंगाल में राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा से जुड़े लंबित इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर कार्यों को प्राथमिकता के साथ पूरा किया जाएगा। साथ ही, यहाँ चतुष्कोणीय सुरक्षा ग्रिड स्थापित होने से सीमा पूरी तरह सुरक्षित और अभेद्य बनेगी। আজ শিলিগুড়িতে ভারত - বাংলাদেশ সীমান্ত সংক্রান্ত নিরাপত্তা বিষয়ক একটি বৈঠক করলাম। মোদী সরকার সীমান্তবর্তী এলাকায় মাদক পাচার, অর্থনৈতিক অপরাধ এবং অনুপ্রবেশের বিরুদ্ধে জিরো টলারেন্স নীতি নিয়ে কাজ করছে। এখন পশ্চিমবঙ্গে জাতীয় নিরাপত্তার সঙ্গে যুক্ত দীর্ঘদিনের পরিকাঠামোগত কাজগুলিকে অগ্রাধিকারের ভিত্তিতে সম্পূর্ণ করা হবে। পাশাপাশি, এখানে চতুষ্কোণীয় নিরাপত্তা গ্রিড গড়ে তোলার মাধ্যমে সীমান্তকে সম্পূর্ণ নিরাপদ ও দুর্ভেদ্য করা হবে।

तीन नए आपराधिक कानूनों से देश की न्याय व्यवस्था तीव्र, पारदर्शी और सिटीजन सेंट्रिक बन रही है। आज पश्चिम बंगाल के सिलीगुड़ी में मुख्यमंत्री श्री @SuvenduWB जी व अन्य वरिष्ठ अधिकारियों के साथ प्रदेश में इन कानूनों के क्रियान्वयन संबंधी समीक्षा बैठक की। ई-साक्ष्य, ई-समन और i-Prison जैसे डिजिटल प्लेटफॉर्म, 7 वर्ष से अधिक सजा वाले अपराधों में अनिवार्य फॉरेंसिक जांच, ज़ीरो FIR और तकनीक के उपयोग वाले ये तीन नए कानून बंगाल में सुशासन और त्वरित न्याय का नया अध्याय शुरू करेंगे। তিনটি নতুন ফৌজদারি আইন দেশের বিচারব্যবস্থাকে আরও দ্রুত, স্বচ্ছ এবং নাগরিক-কেন্দ্রিক করে তুলছে। আজ পশ্চিমবঙ্গের শিলিগুড়িতে মুখ্যমন্ত্রী শ্রী শুভেন্দু অধিকারী মহাশয় ও অন্যান্য ঊর্ধ্বতন আধিকারিকদের সঙ্গে পশ্চিমবঙ্গে এই আইনগুলির বাস্তবায়ন নিয়ে একটি পর্যালোচনা বৈঠক করলাম। ই-সাক্ষ্য, ই-সমন এবং i-Prison-এর মতো ডিজিটাল প্ল্যাটফর্ম, ৭ বছর বা তার বেশি সাজাযোগ্য অপরাধে বাধ্যতামূলক ফরেনসিক তদন্ত, জিরো এফআইআর এবং প্রযুক্তির সর্বোচ্চ ব্যবহারের মাধ্যমে এই তিনটি নতুন ফৌজদারি আইন পশ্চিমবঙ্গে সুশাসন ও দ্রুত বিচার প্রতিষ্ঠার এক নতুন অধ্যায়ের সূচনা করবে।

इन्स्टिट्यूट (FTI) ची बैठक पार पडली. क्वांटम कंप्यूटिंग आणि डीप टेक तंत्रज्ञानामुळे जगभरात मोठी तांत्रिक क्रांती घडत आहे. या तंत्रज्ञानाचा वेग आणि व्याप्ती लक्षात घेता त्याच्याशी त्वरेने जुळवून घेणे आवश्यक असून, त्यासाठी सक्षम आणि सर्वसमावेशक परिसंस्था (इकोसिस्टीम) उभारणे ही काळाची गरज आहे, असे प्रतिपादन मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी केले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, 2024 मध्ये क्वांटम कंप्यूटिंग आणि डीप टेक तंत्रज्ञानाचा जागतिक बाजार सुमारे 2 ते 3 ट्रिलियन डॉलर इतका होता. पुढील 5 वर्षांत तो 16 ट्रिलियन डॉलरपर्यंत पोहोचण्याचा अंदाज आहे. मानवी इतिहासात इतक्या वेगाने वाढणारे तंत्रज्ञान यापूर्वी कधीही पाहायला मिळाले नाही. त्यामुळे या परिवर्तनाचा सक्रिय भाग बनणे भारतासाठी अत्यावश्यक आहे. फ्रंटियर टेक्नॉलॉजीच्या क्षेत्रात सरस कामगिरी करणाऱ्या देशांमध्ये आज भारताची गणना होत आहे. गेल्या दोन-तीन वर्षांत या क्षेत्रात देशाने चांगली प्रगती केली आहे. मात्र, सध्या विविध स्तरांवर सुरू असलेले प्रयत्न विखुरलेले आहेत. त्यांचे संस्थात्मकीकरण केल्यास देशाच्या प्रगतीला अधिक गती मिळू शकते, असे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले. कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता (एआय), सिलिकॉन तंत्रज्ञान आणि क्वांटम कंप्यूटिंग ही जग बदलणारी तंत्रज्ञाने असून, उद्योग-व्यवसायाच्या प्रत्येक क्षेत्रावर त्यांचा मोठा प्रभाव पडणार आहे. या बदलांशी जुळवून घेण्यासाठी मजबूत परिसंस्था उभारावी लागेल. विशेषतः सूक्ष्म, लघु आणि मध्यम उद्योगांना (एमएसएमई) निधी, तांत्रिक क्षमता आणि कौशल्यांच्या अभावामुळे या तंत्रज्ञानाचा पुरेसा लाभ घेता येत नाही. त्यामुळे सर्वांसाठी उपलब्ध असलेले स्मार्ट प्लॅटफॉर्म, सुविधा आणि सक्षम मनुष्यबळ विकसित करणे गरजेचे आहे, असे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले. महाराष्ट्राला जागतिक उत्पादन केंद्र (ग्लोबल मॅन्युफॅक्चरिंग हब) बनविण्यासाठी या अत्याधुनिक तंत्रज्ञानाचा व्यापक प्रसार होणे आवश्यक असून, त्यासाठी या क्षेत्राला समर्पित स्वतंत्र संस्था उभारण्याची गरज आहे. केंद्र सरकारने क्वांटम कंप्यूटिंग तंत्रज्ञानासाठी विविध योजना सुरू केल्या असून, राज्यातील प्रयत्न त्या योजनांशी सुसंगत राहणे आवश्यक आहे. 'मित्रा' संस्था या दिशेने काम करत असून, स्मार्ट मॅन्युफॅक्चरिंग आणि डीप टेक क्षेत्रासाठी प्रभावी धोरणात्मक चौकट तयार करण्यासाठी सर्व संबंधित संस्था आणि धोरणांचे संस्थात्मक एकत्रीकरण करण्याची आवश्यकता आहे, असे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, नवीन सुविधा आणि डिजिटल प्लॅटफॉर्म उभारण्यासाठी राज्य शासन आवश्यक ती गुंतवणूक करण्यास तयार आहे. 'मित्रा'च्या माध्यमातून क्वांटम कंप्यूटिंग प्रशिक्षक तयार करण्याचा उपक्रम राबविण्यात येणार असून, पुढील 2 ते 3 वर्षांत किमान 5000 जणांना या क्षेत्रात प्रशिक्षण देण्याचे उद्दिष्ट आहे. मुंबईत विकसित होत असलेल्या 'इनोव्हेशन सिटी' प्रकल्पासाठी राज्य शासनाने टाटा समूहाशी भागीदारी केली असून, त्याचा आराखडा तयार करण्याचे काम सुरू आहे. फ्रंटियर टेक इन्स्टिट्यूटचा हा उपक्रम आणि इनोव्हेशन सिटीची संकल्पना परस्परपूरक असल्याने या दोन्ही उपक्रमांमध्ये समन्वय साधून काम करता येईल, असेही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी स्पष्ट केले. कार्यक्रमात उपस्थित तज्ज्ञांनी क्वांटम कंप्यूटिंग तंत्रज्ञानाच्या विविध क्षेत्रांतील संधी, संशोधन, उद्योग आणि कौशल्य विकास या विषयांवर सविस्तर चर्चा केली. यावेळी इन्स्टिट्यूटचे कन्व्हेनर दीपक करंजीकर व इतर मान्यवर उपस्थित होते. @Dev_Fadnavis #Maharashtra #DevendraFadnavis #FrontierTechnology

The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) says the number of business licenses registered in the names of women in Afghanistan has increased tenfold over the past five years, with more than 10,000 women now holding formal business licenses. According to a UNDP statement, figures from the Afghanistan Chamber of Commerce and Investment (ACCI) show that an additional 120,000 women are engaged in business activities without formal licenses. UNDP said that despite ongoing restrictions on women’s education and employment, small businesses have become the primary source of income for Afghan women. The statement added that since 2021, UNDP has supported more than 90,000 micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises through grants, equipment, and business development services, with the aim of strengthening women’s economic participation. UNDP also stressed that it will continue its efforts to empower Afghan women economically by expanding Islamic financial services, digital payment systems, and tailored financial solutions for women entrepreneurs. #TOLOnews_English

The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) released a statement claiming its latest strikes were carried out in direct response to recent U.S. attacks on Iranian infrastructure. The IRGC warned that any country hosting U.S. forces used to conduct operations against Iran should expect a "corresponding response" and urged those governments to activate their civil defense systems. According to the IRGC, its latest strikes targeted U.S. military facilities across the Gulf, including Camp Arifjan and Ali Al Salem Air Base in Kuwait, an intelligence site in Bahrain, and additional U.S.-linked military targets in Jordan, Saudi Arabia, Iraq, and Qatar. Notably, the IRGC's warning could also apply to Israel, which has been used as a base for U.S. military operations against Iran. Despite that, the current wave of retaliatory strikes has largely focused on U.S. installations and partner nations in the Gulf rather than Israeli territory. Several Gulf states have also reported Iranian attacks affecting civilian infrastructure, including oil, electricity, water, and airport facilities. Kuwait has confirmed damage to critical infrastructure and injuries to emergency responders and oil sector workers. Bahrain has repeatedly activated air raid sirens as Iranian missiles and drones targeted the island, while Jordan and other regional partners have also reported intercepting Iranian attacks. The IRGC further claimed it killed U.S. personnel, destroyed radar installations, and struck weapons maintenance and drone facilities. Those claims have not been verified. Iranian state and IRGC casualty claims have frequently been exaggerated or later contradicted by subsequent evidence and should be treated with caution until confirmed.

When examining the decision for President Trump to return to war, one thing stands out to me as blatantly negligent: the Risk/Reward proposition. Escalation dominance has been beaten into the minds of every person on earth since the start of this conflict. Do you know WHY? Because it is overwhelming, it is fundamental, and it is not going to CHANGE regardless of what the United States does. Let’s look at… the absolute best case scenario for those in Washington. Regime Change. Under a regime change theory, at least now during this part of the war, it wouldn’t happen “fast” like one may have through during the immediate strikes in February. No, now there will be signs. It will take time. And in the best case, would happen simultaneously during the war. Do we expect the Iranian regime to just… roll over? Throw up their hands and call it quits? Sprint to the negotiating table? No, of course not. Because they CAN’T make concessions on their nuclear file, their missile and drone R&D, or their proxy funding. Why? Because then they would lose all legitimacy and credibility inside of Iran, which would lead to what? Regime change. And what happens if there is regime change? The Iranian leadership is either killed or imprisoned. There’s not a scenario in which they just reintegrate into society, live a happy life, and everything moves forward filled with sunshine, rainbows, and roses. Cmon now. In the best-case scenario, the regime will see popular uprisings coming from a mile away. So what is their incentive in this instance? You guessed it. They will escalate massively. Because by escalating, they may be able to force the United States to the table, get an economic shot in the arm, and be able to focus on putting down the uprisings. Escalate massively? Escalation dominance? Yes, in the “best case” scenario, the Iranian regime will go down in a HUGE pile of brass. Striking water desalination plants across the Gulf, torching the Yanbu pipeline, destroying Gulf energy infrastructure, striking vessels in the Bab al-Mandeb, and causing a global catastrophe. That’s… the “good scenario” we have laid out before us. In the “middle” or “bad” scenario, we are laying the groundwork for there to be a humanitarian crisis inside of Iran with no benefit to the United States to show for it. The blockade and economic warfare campaign, at its most fundamental level, is meant to cause hyperinflation, a collapse of the Rial, food shortages, and medical supply shortages. Do you know who that hurts the most? The very Iranian people we claim to have launched this war to HELP. And in that middle and worse-case scenario? Not only is the Iranian regime still in power, but they now control the Strait of Hormuz, they will receive billions of dollars worth of concessions, and most importantly of all, they will have permanently cemented their power by proving to the Iranian people that the United States is the “Great Satan” after all. There is simply not a reality in which the United States can achieve our core strategic objectives in this conflict without extraordinary repercussions for the world. We are already seeing the signs of what is to come just in the last 48 hours with Kuwaiti water desalination and power plants being struck. From a Risk/Reward standpoint, the decision from President Trump to return to war is one that offers an exceptionally low likelihood of “success”, a high likelihood of catastrophic downsides, and even more notably, catastrophic downsides in the very “success” scenario we are trying to achieve. It’s time for President Trump to make the wise choice. The rational choice. To put the best interests of the American people before his own. It’s time to leave.

MARC ANDREESSEN WENT ON ROGAN FOR OVER 3 HOURS. HERE ARE THE 17 THINGS WORTH YOUR ATTENTION. 1. AGI is already here, in his view. He says the line got crossed about 3 months ago with GPT-5.5, Claude 4.6, Gemini 3, and Grok 4.3, and nobody noticed because the field moves too fast to register milestones anymore. 2. For almost any topic, he says the top models now give him better answers than the world-class experts he could call by phone, and he can call almost anyone. Worth noting he has not published data behind this, and a separate Nature Medicine study on a comparable AI health tool found it missed real emergencies more than half the time. Take the claim seriously, verify it yourself. 3. His claim on doctors: they are already using ChatGPT in the exam room, typing your symptoms in the moment you stop talking. His actual quote: "at that point you're asking the question of like, what do I need you for." 4. Reportedly, when AI declines to answer something, he tells it he's writing a novel to get past the refusal. 5. Reportedly, his technique for hard topics is escalating simplicity: explain it like I'm 10, then 5, then 2, until it clicks. 6. Reportedly, instead of asking for the "right" answer, he has the AI steelman both sides of a hard question, then decides himself. 7. Reportedly, for big questions he has the AI role-play a panel of experts arguing with each other. 8. His broader point: the moment you think "I don't know how to figure this out" is exactly when most people give up, and exactly when you should open the AI instead. 9. His view: the only real skill left is knowing what to ask. The bottleneck is in your head, not the model. 10. He describes sending AI photos, rashes, blood tests, for a fast second opinion, since current models read images directly. 11. He points to CBT as the one clinically proven therapy type that AI can plausibly deliver on its own, meaning real therapeutic support becomes freely available at scale. 12. He cites AI cracking previously unsolved math problems, with early signs of the same happening in physics, chemistry, and biology. 13. Reportedly, he claims the top AI coders in Silicon Valley now earn as much as $50 million a year, which he uses as a signal of how large this shift actually is. 14. Reportedly, a friend paid to sequence his own DNA, fed it to an AI along with blood work and wearable data, and got back a working health dashboard. 15. Reportedly, another friend set up cameras in his home jiu-jitsu gym so AI could review his sparring and give him technique notes. 16. He coined the term "AI vampire" for the pattern of people working more and sleeping less because AI keeps making more output possible, a real term he used, though the framing around it varies by account. 17. His extrapolation: one person eventually running many AI coding agents, each reviewing the others, describing this as close, not years out. Watch the full interview before treating any single number as settled. Several of these are Andreessen's stated views and anecdotes, not independently verified facts. पुण्याची वाहतूक कोंडीतून होणार सुटका, 3 उन्नत महामार्गांचे भूमिपूजन मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस आणि केंद्रीय मंत्री नितीन गडकरी यांच्या हस्ते आज पुणे-शिरुर उन्नत द्रुतगती महामार्ग, तळेगाव-चाकण-शिक्रापूर उन्नत महामार्ग, हडपसर-यवत उन्नत महामार्ग या पुण्यातील 3 उन्नत महामार्गांचे भूमिपूजन संपन्न झाले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, या 3 महामार्गांचे भूमिपूजन हे पुण्याच्या वाहतुकीची समस्या सोडवण्याच्या दिशेने महत्त्वपूर्ण पाऊल आहे. विशेषतः पुण्याबाहेरील महत्त्वाच्या औद्योगिक वसाहतींना जोडणाऱ्या रस्त्यांवरील वाहतूक समस्येवर यामुळे कायमस्वरुपी उपाय मिळणार आहे. या तीन रस्ते प्रकल्पांमध्ये प्रथमच बिल्ड-ऑपरेट-ट्रान्सफर (BOT) नवीन पद्धतीचा अवलंब करण्यात आला आहे. त्यामुळे केवळ टोलचा महसूल नव्हे तर संबंधित प्रकल्पातून सरकारला अपफ्रंट (Upfront) निधी मिळणार आहे. या नव्या मॉडेलनुसार पहिल्या प्रकल्पातून ₹500 कोटी, दुसऱ्या प्रकल्पातून ₹300 कोटी, तर तिसऱ्या प्रकल्पातून ₹150 कोटी थेट सरकारला प्राप्त होणार आहेत. हा निधी भूसंपादनासाठी मोठा फायदेशीर ठरेल. पुणे-शिरूर मार्गाची एकूण लांबी 53.4 किमी आहे. यापैकी 35 किलोमीटरचा चौपदरी उन्नत (Elevated) मार्ग उभारण्यात येणार असून, त्याखाली 4 पदरी जमिनीला समांतर सेवा रस्ता असेल. तर तळेगाव-चाकण-शिक्रापूर मार्गाची एकूण लांबी 53.20 किमी आहे. यात 26 किमीचा उन्नत मार्ग आहे. तसेच हडपसर ते यवत मार्ग 31 किमी लांबीचा रस्ता असून यात 6 पदरी उन्नत आणि 6 पदरी जमिनीलगत रस्ता असेल, यामुळे प्रवासाचा किमान 50 मिनिटांचा वेळ वाचेल, तसेच इंधनाची बचत होऊन प्रदूषण कमी होईल, असे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले. पुणे-शिरूर आणि हडपसर-यवत मार्गाच्या रचनेबाबत मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, एलिव्हेटेड रोड आणि त्यावर मेट्रो असे दुहेरी (Double Decker) मॉडेल विकसित करण्यात आले आहे. या रचनेमुळे भविष्यात मेट्रो प्रकल्पाच्या खर्चात तब्बल 40% बचत होणार आहे. या तिन्ही प्रकल्पांसाठी 4 वर्षांचा कालावधी निश्चित करण्यात आला असला, तरी BOT पद्धतीमुळे काम अधिक वेगाने पूर्ण करण्याचे निर्देश देण्यात आले असल्याचेही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, पुरंदर विमानतळाचे भूसंपादन वेगाने पूर्ण होत असून, याच वर्षी निविदा प्रक्रिया पूर्ण करून प्रत्यक्ष काम सुरू करण्याचा प्रयत्न आहे. विमानतळ पूर्ण होईपर्यंत आवश्यक रस्ता आणि मेट्रो कनेक्टिव्हिटीही उपलब्ध करून देण्यात येईल. पुणे आणि पिंपरी-चिंचवडच्या भविष्यातील गरजा लक्षात घेऊन पिण्याचे पाणी, सांडपाणी प्रक्रिया आणि समान पाणीवाटपासाठी दीर्घकालीन नियोजन करण्यात येत आहे. तसेच पुणे हे अभियांत्रिकी, स्टार्टअप आणि डीप टेकचे प्रमुख केंद्र म्हणून विकसित होत असून, नव्या पायाभूत सुविधांमुळे शहराच्या विकासाला आणखी गती मिळेल. यावेळी उपमुख्यमंत्री सुनेत्रा अजित पवार, मंत्री चंद्रकांत पाटील, मंत्री शिवेंद्रसिंहराजे भोसले, राज्यमंत्री माधुरी मिसाळ, खासदार श्रीरंग आप्पा बारणे, पुण्याच्या महापौर मंजुषा नागपुरे व 3/ 🚨 Iran’s interception rate is 90%+. That’s not the story — it’s the cost of the story. UAE alone has intercepted 537 ballistic missiles, 2,256 drones since Feb. Bahrain has burned ~87% of its Patriot stock doing it. Iran’s arsenal has shrunk ~2,500→~1,000 missiles, 60%+ launchers destroyed. This week’s Kuwait/Jordan hits aren’t a resurgence — it’s a degraded force still scoring occasional hits against defenses running low on ammo faster than they can restock. Who runs out first?

Signal over noise: here’s what is actually confirmed (July 14–18). ✅ Kuwait: A power/desalination plant was damaged. ✅ Jordan: US-used bases were hit, with several US personnel injured. Jordan also confirmed intercepting four incoming missiles. ❌ Claims of strikes on Al Udeid, US fatalities, and major hits in Bahrain, Oman or Syria remain unverified as of now. The picture is clear: Iran can still penetrate some defenses, but the scale remains limited—not the mass saturation campaign seen at the start of the war. #OSINT #MiddleEast #Iran

1/ Iran isn’t defeated. It’s degraded. The shift is visible in the numbers. After opening the war with 500+ ballistic missiles and 2,000+ drones in four days, Iran’s launch tempo collapsed by roughly 90%. Today’s attacks are smaller, dispersed across multiple fronts, and appear designed to stretch Gulf air defenses rather than overwhelm them. Tehran still retains strike capability—but it’s now fighting a rationed harassment campaign, not the saturation barrages seen at the start of the war. Quantity has given way to conservation. #Iran #MiddleEast #OSINT Video

Saray, @DianaSaray ignoro cuántas personas han sido reparadas económicamente, pero el Acuerdo tenía varios pilares: verdad, justicia, reparación y garantías de no repetición. De lo que sí puede dar fe el país es de que militares han confesado miles de falsos positivos y excomandantes de las Farc han reconocido secuestros, reclutamiento y otros crímenes que durante décadas negaron. Esa verdad también es una forma de reparación para muchas víctimas. El Congreso dejó por fuera a terceros civiles y parapolíticos, una de las grandes falencias del sistema, y por eso el proceso quedó incompleto. Pero las verdades han hecho tanto daño colateral a la derecha que Duque y ADLE anuncian acabar la JEP. Duque no pudo, no sabemos si Abelardo lo logre. Sobre la No repetición, la mayoría ha cumplido. De los más de 20 congresistas que tuvieron las FARC solo uno regresó a la guerra. Y de los excombatientes, más del 80% se han mantenido al margen de la violencia. El Acuerdo es imperfecto y su implementación ha sido lento, pero afirmar que no sirvió para nada desconoce avances reales en verdad, justicia y reconocimiento de responsabilidades. Para muchas víctimas, eso también ha sido reparación. Pueda que esto sea poco para personas que no han sido afectadas por la violencia, pero para las víctimas es sanador. La paz perfecta no existe. Pero mil veces un Acuerdo imperfecto que una guerra perfecta y eterna. Diana Saray - EnLaDiana (@DianaSaray) He recibido muchos mensajes de quienes fueron parte de la construcción del Acuerdo de Paz insistiendo en que este fue un acuerdo que tuvo como eje a las víctimas. Sin embargo, hasta el día de hoy no he encontrado ninguna víctima de las Farc que se sienta reconocida con este acuerdo. Por eso quiero preguntar en esta red si hay aquí alguna víctima de las Farc que sienta que sí fue reparada y que en su caso se cumplieron las garantías de verdad, justicia y no repetición. Були на звʼязку бригадний генерал Дмитро Волошин, командир 8-го корпусу ДШВ, генерал-майор Артем Богомолов, командир 10-го армійського корпусу, бригадний генерал Олексій Майстренко, командир 11-го армійського корпусу, бригадний генерал Євген Ласійчук, командир 7-го корпусу швидкого реагування ДШВ, бригадний генерал Святослав Заїць, командир 20-го армійського корпусу, та бригадний генерал Ярослав Сидоров, командир 17-го армійського корпусу. Хлопці, вдячний усім за змістовні доповіді. Обговорили необхідне постачання зброї та засобів для ведення бойових дій, реалізації ротацій, захисту нашої логістики й знищення логістики росіян. Потрібно більше далекобійної артилерії – снарядів 155-го калібру. Визначили, які додаткові засоби для мідлстрайків мають бути поставлені. Будемо говорити з виробниками й усіма, хто забезпечує постачання, про додаткові можливості. Дякую всім розробникам та виробникам НРК: це очевидний пріоритет для військ, і постачання має збільшуватись. Обговорили також оперативну інформацію щодо завдань окупанта, які росіяни намагаються реалізувати, та перспектив нашої активної оборони. Сирський несе персональну відповідальність за систему, яку він будує в армії. Штурмові полки, ситуація у 425-му полку «Скеля», свідчення про небойові смерті, побиття, катування і незаконне утримання людей,замовне вбивство екс командиром 155 бригади ( колишнім НШ 425 полку Скеля) масове СЗЧ та кримінальні справи щодо викрадень і вбивств. Це наслідки системи управління, у якій командири відчувають безкарність, а солдат дедалі частіше сприймається як безправний ресурс. No civilian fatalities or injuries from the debris have been reported. The ministry says Kuwaiti forces remain on high alert and continue to conduct air defense operations in coordination with other government agencies. Este Mundial es el más random de la historia. Entre las cosas que han pasado están: - Las dos estrellas de los finalistas salieron en una foto una bañando a la otra - El árbitro de la final fue arrestado por estar en una orgía con drogas y armas - El presidente de un país llamó a la FIFA para anular una suspensión… y lo logró - El país beneficiado fue luego humillado en su propia casa, por un rival que no había podido ganarle ni a Egipto ni a Irán - Un portero de 40 años desempleado de un país africano al que nadie ha ido fue el único que logró parar a los dos finalistas en 90 minutos - Solo pudo ser vencido por un jugador de 39 años, que de paso ha sido el mejor del Mundial - La mitad del mundo cree que hay una conspiración de la FIFA para ayudar a ese jugador a ser campeón del mundo - Algunos de ellos piensan que, de algún modo, está involucrado Israel - La final, en lugar de jugarse en el estadio más mítico del mundo, se jugará a 35 grados en medio del humo de incendios forestales - 10 de los 11 jugadores de una selección no nacieron en su país - Los 11 jugadores de otra selección no nacieron en su país - Ninguna de esas selecciones es Francia, a la que todos acusan de no tener jugadores nacidos en su país, pero en realidad son 23 de 26 nacidos en territorio francés - Los aficionados de una selección se inventaron amenazas del crimen organizado para justificar una derrota humillante - Una selección tuvo que viajar de un país a otro ida y vuelta cada vez que jugaba, porque el país organizador lo invadió antes del torneo - El mejor árbitro de un continente no pudo participar en el torneo porque el organizador no lo dejó entrar - Un campeón del mundo no pasó un grupo con Arabia y Cabo Verde, otro fue eliminado por Paraguay, uno más ni siquiera calificó - El entrenador de uno de esos países acusó a sus jugadores de no poder poner atención a una charla de 10 minutos - Uno de los equipos importantes vio interrumpida su preparación por una balacera, un robo y un tornado Estoy seguro que eso no es todo ¿qué me faltó?

VIDEO | English manager Stephen Constantine, who guided India to a historic high in the FIFA rankings, is deeply disappointed by the country's current freefall and believes he should still be at the helm managing the team. The 63-year-old English tactician was shortlisted to be the coach of Indian national team for a third tenure before Khalid Jamil was roped in and handed a full-time contract. In an exclusive interview with PTI from Rwanda, where he manages the national team, he partly blamed the All India Football Federation (AIFF) for the downfall. He stated they should have done more to maintain stability after the ISL agreement ended. Additionally, he called for wider structural reforms, including promotion and relegation, youth development, and a clear coaching pathway. "I should have been in India, but I'm not. When you give seven years of your life to the national team, I have a personal interest, of course, I was shortlisted for the Indian job this time. They put Khalid Jamil. OK, fair enough.But Khalid Jamil has zero experience at international football. Now, if you are wanting an Indian coach, then put the Indian coach in a position where he can he can develop," he said. Скеля неефективна у використанні мобілізаційного ресурсу. Але не лише. Наявність Скелі з її репутацією мʼясного підрозділу-чорна-діра сильно знижує і ефективність всього війська. Не лише через негативний вплив на мобілізацію, мотивацію, не лише через знищення «здорової конкуренції» в забезпеченні людьми, зброєю, засобами. Існування Скелі створює небезпечну ілюзію, що ця чорна діра є якоюсь «зброєю останнього шансу». Що якщо в діп і міллстрайки не вийде, якщо ворожу логістику не зможем винести, якщо в технології і складні продумані успішні операції не складеться, то ж є ще скеля, яка аморальна, страшна, гидка, але на війні всі засоби згодяться і вона своїм мʼясом все вивезе. І ми не потонемо. Не вивезе. Потонемо. Ця чорна зловіща діра, якщо прибрати з неї весь фльор і чесно порахувати kpi (ресурси на вході/результат) виявиться пшиком. Чим вона і є власне з військової точки зору. Євген Строкань (@14druzivBanderi) Сирський Скеля і Федоров (продовження вчорашніх текстів) Полк Скеля з його надмірними втратами був однією з причин непорозуміння Федорова з Сирським. Цієї зими я був під Покровськом в сусідній від Скали смузі і особисто бачив багато про що не можу розповісти як військовослужбовець, але у мене тоді сформувалась претензія до Скелі, яку, чомусь, мало хто озвучує. Справа в тому, що у Скелі недостатня ефективність, особливо на фоні їхніх втрат. На наших рубежах ми майже не отримували поповнення, тому намагались завести бійців на позиції без втрат. Нашу оборону дуже підкошувала кожна втрата бо резервів не було зовсім і тому ми дуже раділи коли в якісь дні ми не втрачали нікого, а підорів єбашили по 15 рил, зʼявлялось відчуття, що ми не дарма там воюємо, бо підори втрачають значно більше ніж ми, що рахунок все одно на нашу користь, але вся ця радість зникала, коли вияснялось, що Скеля втрачала за той самий день понад 15 бійців. Тобто Скеля тягнула всю команду вниз. І можна було б подумати, що всі ці втрати супроводжувались якимись успіхами на фронті, але насправді все навпаки, їхня оборона провалювалась і вони нам оголили фланг. Я тоді проаналізував що вони робили не так і навіть дискутував з людьми які захищали їхню методику і зараз спробую коротко описати основні помилки які памʼятаю. 1) рух ос на позицію дуже часто відбуваєвся без плащів, в дуже ясну погоду і по маршрутам які погано зрозумілі бійцям. Мені на це відповіли, що Скеля отримує дуже хуйовий особовий склад і тому їх так заводять, щоб чітко контролювати їхні дії з наших дронів. Але я вважаю, що це повна херня. Справа в тому, що бійця в плащі все одно видно, просто видно гірше, тому пілот який їх веде все одно буде їх бачити бо знає де вони, а підорська фпв може і не помітити бо не знає де вони. Також і погоду можна підібрати таку яка зменшить помітність групи, але все одно дозволить спостерігати її з нашого мавіка. Ну і самий важливий аргумент, що від втрати групи ще до захода на позицію все одно не буде ніякої користі🤌. 2) вони постійно намагались відправити піхоту занадто далеко, майже в тил противнику, замість того щоб вибудувати ешеловану оборону яку буде тяжко прожати. Ця практика сильно множить втрати в комбінації з першою описаною проблемою. 3) відправляють на бойові погано підготовлених бійців. Взагалі не бачу сенс пихати вперед солдата який все одно не готовий вступити в стрілецький бій. Він і морально не готовий і не навчений це робити. Ми там теж отримали піхоту відразу після бзвп, але якісна підготовка зробила з них матьорих рембо, які єбошили підорів як леви. Взагалі війна під Покровськом була сама відчайдушна з того, що я бачив, але більшість втрат були не виправдані і можна було б виконати задачу якісніше і з меншою кількістю втрат. Я взагалі давно хотів написати про події на тому напрямку, але розумію, що це буде занадто демотивуюче, тому я це відкладаю. Але вважаю, що саме зараз є необхідність озвучити хоча б ці проблеми, а це насправді крихта.
