Zgodnie z wcześniejszą zapowiedzią Prezydenta RP Karola Nawrockiego, w nadchodzącym tygodniu Prezydent ponownie złoży do Senatu wniosek o referendum w sprawie przyszłości unijnej polityki klimatycznej. Wczoraj Komisja Europejska przedstawiła długo zapowiadaną propozycję zmian w systemie ETS – najbardziej kosztownym elemencie unijnej polityki klimatycznej, który od ponad 20 lat obciąża europejską gospodarkę. Po wcześniejszych zapowiedziach przedstawicieli rządu zapewniających o wywalczeniu w Brukseli realnej reformy, można było oczekiwać przełomu. Niestety, opublikowany projekt pokazuje, że zamiast rzeczywistych zmian mamy do czynienia jedynie z pozornymi korektami. Prezydent Karol Nawrocki już w marcu przedstawił konkretne propozycje zmian w systemie ETS, które mogłyby skutecznie chronić polski i europejski przemysł przed skutkami obecnych regulacji. Złożył również wniosek o referendum, wychodząc z założenia, że o tak fundamentalnych kwestiach powinni zdecydować sami Polacy. Większość rządząca odrzuciła tę inicjatywę, przekonując, że nie jest ona potrzebna, ponieważ rząd wynegocjuje w Brukseli rozwiązania odpowiadające polskim interesom. Dziś znamy już efekty tych zapowiedzi. Komisja Europejska proponuje około 10 mld euro ulg wynikających ze zmienionych benchmarków dla całego unijnego przemysłu do 2030 roku. Dla porównania – tylko polskie przedsiębiorstwa otrzymywały dotychczas około 3 mld euro darmowych uprawnień rocznie. Do 2034 roku koszt wygaszenia tych uprawnień dla polskiej gospodarki szacowany jest na około 13 mld euro. To oznacza, że jeden kraj poniesie większe straty niż wartość ulg przewidzianych dla całej Unii Europejskiej. Podobnie wygląda sytuacja z Funduszem Modernizacyjnym. Komisja przedstawia jego zwiększenie jako znaczące ustępstwo, jednak mowa o 280 mln uprawnień do podziału między 12 państw, podczas gdy same polskie przedsiębiorstwa umarzają około 150 mln uprawnień rocznie. To pokazuje skalę tej „pomocy”. Trudno uznać ją za realne wsparcie dla przemysłu. To nie jest reforma, lecz próba przykrycia wielomiliardowych kosztów symbolicznymi gestami. Europa potrzebuje dziś polityki przemysłowej odbudowującej konkurencyjność gospodarki po latach narastających kosztów obecnego modelu polityki klimatycznej. Tymczasem przedstawiona rewizja ETS sprawia jedynie wrażenie zmiany. Zapowiadana „łagodniejsza ścieżka redukcji” nie zmienia kierunku polityki – oznacza jedynie wolniejsze zwiększanie obciążeń dla przedsiębiorstw. Gorset regulacyjny nie staje się luźniejszy, lecz będzie zaciskał się nieco wolniej. To nie jest ulga. To jedynie odroczenie problemu. Europa traci dziś konkurencyjność, a odpowiedzią Komisji Europejskiej pozostaje kosmetyka zamiast rzeczywistej zmiany kursu. Tym razem Senat nie zasłoni się „tezą” w pytaniu referendalnym. Oczekujemy, że dopusci do rzetelnej debaty i umożliwi Polakom wypowiedzenie się w tej fundamentalnej dla przyszłości polskiej gospodarki i bezpieczeństwa energetycznego sprawie.

PAKISTAN: Sanitation workers keep our cities running, yet many continue to work in conditions that put their lives at risk. On 4 July, two sanitation workers died and another was critically injured after inhaling toxic gases while cleaning a manhole in Chishtian, Punjab. Their deaths are the latest in a series of preventable tragedies involving sanitation workers carrying out dangerous sewer-cleaning work without adequate protection. Based on media reports, at least 16 sanitation workers have died since April 2026. Their deaths were linked to suffocation and exposure to toxic fumes while manually cleaning sewers. The dangers sanitation workers face extend beyond sewer cleaning. On 1 June, a sanitation worker was crushed to death while sweeping a road. Days later, another sanitation worker set himself on fire in Gujranwala after allegedly facing unpaid wages and unlawful salary deductions. He died from his injuries on 28 June. Reports indicate that he had repeatedly raised concerns about insufficient wages before his death.

Every time an Odhuvar sings, he repeats a sound heard in that exact spot for 20 to 30 generations without a break. When he stops, that link ends. Read the full story by @CranksCorner here: swarajyamag.com/culture/sans…

Only the wealthy temples pay Rs 15,000 to Rs 35,000 a month. Odhuvars in small rural temples earn far less and often live on tips from devotees. Few young people will train for 7 years for that kind of pay, so the schools are emptying out.

The pay explains a lot. In 1980 an Odhuvar got Rs 175 a month and two cups of temple rice. Decades later it was still a few thousand rupees. In 2017 a High Court judge ordered a fix, saying their service cannot be measured by a clock.

As I reflect on my time at #HLPF, one central thread ran through my bilateral discussions. Rural transformation will not be delivered by any one institution or source of finance. It requires governments, international financial institutions, the private sector, philanthropy and the UN system to align capital and expertise behind country-led priorities. With #Japan’s State Minister for Foreign Affairs, @ayano_kunimitsu, we discussed our partnership on food security, nutrition and rural investment. Through initiatives such as the Enhanced Linkages between Private Sector and Small-scale Producers programme in Tanzania, we are also building stronger markets and public-private-producer partnerships. Japan’s leadership helps to scale this approach through #IFAD14. #Malawi’s Minister of Local Government and Rural Development, Dr Hon Ben Phiri, and I discussed IFAD's investments in the country, which helps small-scale producers to transition from subsistence towards commercial agriculture. With @SpainUN’s, Héctor Gómez, we reflected on #Spain’s long-standing leadership in innovative development finance. Its pioneering EUR300 million food-security facility enabled IFAD to expand concessional financing across 24 countries, while our current co-financing framework is supporting investments in countries across Latin America and Africa. @UNOPS Executive Director @UNOPS_Chief and I explored how IFAD’s financing capabilities and UNOPS’ expertise can be brought together more systematically particularly in fragile and crisis-affected settings. Rural infrastructure is not simply a construction challenge, it connects farmers to markets, services and economic opportunity and the development of a local private sector. My discussion with @RockefellerFdn Executive Vice President Elizabeth Yee focused on moving from strategic alignment to operational partnership and exploring the agriculture-energy nexus where are work and priorities can create synergies. Finally, in my meeting with @UN Deputy Secretary-General @AminaJMohammed, I reaffirmed IFAD’s commitment to accelerating the #SDGs and UN80. IFAD is putting these commitments into practice by combining concessional lending, grants, guarantees, sustainable bonds and direct private-sector investment to mobilize capital for markets, employment and resilience. @IFAD will continue bringing governments, IFIs, public development banks, investors and partners together to ensure that global finance reaches the first mile, where it can strengthen local economies before the next crisis arrives. #FinancingTheFirstMile | #HLPF2026

You can look at his entirely vindicated libertarian antiwar position on the Iran War and see why it’s so wrong. Balaji (@balajis) Should the global tech community continue investing in Malaysia? Given recent events, I raise this question respectfully for the consideration of Prime Minister Yang Amat Berhormat Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim (@anwaribrahim), for the people of Malaysia, and for our friends in the Malaysian tech community. The answer will be of interest to anyone in global tech that’s considering building, investing, or expanding in Malaysia, including executives at Google, Amazon, Apple, and Microsoft, founders of tech unicorns like Coinbase and Solana, and investors at the world’s largest venture capital funds like a16z and Polychain. As context, I am the former CTO of Coinbase and former General Partner at a16z. In October 2024, I opened a startup society called Network School in Malaysia, because I felt I’d been invited in by the government’s pro-tech policies. Specifically, the KL20 initiative set out Malaysia’s ambition of becoming a top 20 global tech hub. Their MDEC digital nomad visas and MM2H investor visas were created to facilitate an influx of global talent and capital. And the Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone was announced to facilitate the flow of capital and talent between Malaysia and Singapore, where I live. When taken in combination with Malaysia’s datacenter buildout and its policy of welcoming visa-free visits for 98% of the world, it seemed like Malaysia might be a great place to build a global tech hub that was simultaneously inexpensive and easy to visit (especially for non-Westerners). And that’s what we did, by creating Network School. It’s an international tech community with its first node in Forest City, Malaysia. We picked Forest City because it had millions of square feet of empty space, because it was one hour from Singapore’s capital markets, and because it was within the Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone. Then, within 18 months, without a single penny of government money, we built Network School into a global attraction that brought thousands of engineers, investors, and builders from 70+ countries to learn technology, burn calories, earn online, and have fun, integrating with the local Malaysian economy along the way. Indeed, in terms of quantifiable contribution to the Malaysian economy, we’ve already invested 100M+ MYR in our campus to make it startup-friendly. For perspective, that’s about 4% of the budget of Johor, the Malaysian state where Forest City is located. We employ dozens of Malaysians directly and indirectly at every level from executive to staff. We’ve backed Malaysian tech startups like Collektr, hosted events for local teams like Superteam Malaysia, and are major customers of many local businesses like barbers, laundromats, and restaurants. We’ve also revitalized the multibillion-dollar Forest City project, causing millions of MYR in real estate appreciation. And, as the video below describes, we were on the cusp of a 500M+ MYR expansion to grow our community, as well as a global merit scholarship with my friend Amjad Masad of Replit. However, that emerging multi-billion dollar success story — which should rightfully have been hailed as a huge victory for the pro-tech policies of the Malaysian government — is at risk of being derailed by a fake story spread by an anonymous account named MP4P. In short: on the day before the July 11 Johor elections, MP4P posted an Instagram post falsely accusing Network School of harboring illegal aliens. The sensational accusations caused a tizzy in Malaysia, until Malaysian authorities came to our campus on July 14 to investigate. (I should note that the officers were very polite and professional.) After checking hundreds of physical passports from 40 countries, including dual passport holders, the authorities confirmed to the press on July 15 that all travel documents were in order. During the process, we cooperated fully; in the thread below you can see a photo of the men, women, and children of Network School smiling and holding up their passports in the bright daylight. Our faces are shown and our names are known; we have nothing to hide. With that said, the process is the punishment. What MP4P did is very similar to the American crime of “swatting”, because MP4P created a hoax report of a serious threat, thereby forcing the Malaysian police to take time away from protecting the Malaysian people towards investigating a nonexistent issue. Moreover, this anonymous MP4P account has also called for Malaysia to boycott Apple, Google, Amazon, and Microsoft…a move that would cost ordinary Malaysians thousands of jobs…even while MP4P’s own Instagram collaborators promote their Apple and Google apps! I mean, we aren’t talking about a credible accuser, but just someone screaming inconsistently at the top of their lungs on social media for traffic, an all-too-common phenomenon these days. Anyway, at this point, all further investment we were planning to make in Malaysia is on hold until we get sufficient assurance that such issues won’t recur. So are the investment plans of many of our friends, including the execs and investors at global tech firms that we brought to Forest City. Because to put it very plainly: we have invested 100M+ MYR in Malaysia, while creating jobs for dozens of Malaysians, and our faces and names are known. Our Malaysian executives and employees deserve the benefit of the doubt over anonymous internet trolls. There are two paths forward. In the first case, if Malaysia still wants continued global tech investment, if it wants to be a top 20 tech hub, if it wants us to revitalize Forest City, then we request an audience with the Prime Minister’s office to discuss the terms of a memorandum of understanding between Network School and the Malaysian government, similar to the document recently signed between the Solana Foundation and the Kazakhstan government. Specifics can of course be discussed, but we would publicly commit to abiding by all Malaysian laws (we already do) and respecting Malaysia’s sovereignty (never in question). In return, they’d get to know our friendly community, and realize that we actually chose Malaysia because we thought it was a great place to build a tech hub where engineers from the global South, investors from the West, and builders from Malaysia itself could meet new people, build cool things, and perhaps create millions of dollars in economic growth in the fullness of time. That vision of peace and trade, internationalism and entrepreneurialism, is still on the table. We aren’t asking for any money — just a meeting, to help restore confidence in Malaysia as an investable jurisdiction. Alternatively, if you don’t want our investment, or those of our colleagues at billion dollar funds and trillion dollar companies, we will of course respect your wishes, and reallocate our capital to other countries instead. 🚨 1,000 km Deep Strike Capability — Why this matters for Bharat. 🇮🇳 The Indian Army isn’t just pursuing another long-range loitering munition. It’s laying the foundation for a sovereign autonomous strike ecosystem under the Make-II framework. The proposed LRLM combines a 1,000 km range, AI-enabled target recognition, GPS-denied navigation, nap-of-earth flight and a 25 kg warhead. But the real story isn’t the specifications. It’s the Army’s emphasis on indigenous engines, avionics, seekers, mission software, flight-control computers and manufacturing—ensuring future upgrades remain in Indian hands. Modern wars have shown that the decisive advantage comes not from buying platforms, but from owning the software, sensors and industrial base behind them. From Astra, Akash, Pinaka, BrahMos and Tejas to a future indigenous LRLM, India’s defence modernisation is increasingly following one principle: Build in India. Control in India. Upgrade in India. That’s what strategic autonomy looks like. 🇮🇳 #IndianArmy #AatmanirbharBharat #MakeInIndia #Defence Video

After EOD School I was assigned to Technical Escort Center, Edgewood Arsenal, Maryland. One day, I walked off post to a sub sandwich shop. Upon returning to post, a guy pulled up in a car and rolled his window down. He asked me why I wasn't in school. I was puzzled. Turns out, he was the local Truant Officer. I told him that I wasn't in school because I was in the Army. I told a friend Mike Campbell about it, and to this day, he still brings it up. I was 18 years old at that time. In this photo, I'm 19, an SP/4, and on my way to Vietnam. I guess if I looked this young at 19, I probably looked a little younger at 18 when the Truant Officer inquired. What I've realized is this -- no matter your age, if you work hard and focus on the present, you're just you. Looks and age become irrelevant.

Na segunda das agendas de saúde desta sexta no Rio de Janeiro, visitei o Instituto Nacional de Traumatologia e Ortopedia (Into), unidade de referência em serviços de alta complexidade e tecnologia pelo SUS. Reestruturada nos últimos anos, ganhou escala e se modernizou. De 400 cirurgias por mês, passou para 1,1 mil. Especializado no uso de tecnologia para tratamentos ortopédicos, o Into realiza consultas, exames, internações e cirurgias, com uso inclusive de tecnologia de impressão 3D na produção de próteses para reabilitação. O próximo passo será a implantação de cirurgia robótica em ortopedia. O Into integra a reestruturação da rede federal de saúde no Rio, que também inclui a contratação de 1,4 mil profissionais para os institutos nacionais de Câncer e de Cardiologia, além do reforço das equipes em outros seis hospitais federais. 📸 @ricardostuckert

Haaretz Exposé: Israel's plan to topple the Iranian regime - and how PM Netanyahu drew inspiration from the forces of al-Julani, the Syrian rebel leader | This week, we published an investigation - the deepest dive yet into Israel's plan to topple the Iranian regime and install Ahmadinejad as its new leader. In November 2024, the world watched in astonishment as the Syrian regime rapidly collapsed in the face of the rebel offensive. According to several Israeli sources, Prime Minister Netanyahu was captivated by what the militia led by the jihadist al-Julani had accomplished - the man who would soon become Syria's president under the name Ahmad al-Sharaa. "Al-Julani basically inspired the prime minister to topple the Iranian regime," says a source who took part in the security discussions at the time. "After what happened in Syria, he went to the Mossad and said that to overthrow the Iranian regime, they needed boots on the ground - armed fighters who could ignite unrest." The inspiration from al-Julani gave birth to the Kurdish plan: arming and training militias in Iraqi Kurdistan and providing air support for their invasion of Iran from the west. Yet even before the Mossad began to concoct this scheme, it raised more than a few eyebrows across the defense establishment. Within the Mossad itself, there was genuine unease. Syria was a fractured and impoverished country to begin with, several sources point out, and by 2024, after 13 years of war, it was utterly devastated. Comparing the Syrians to the Iranians borders on a loss of touch with reality. Iran, the sources add, is an economic power with a population nearly four times larger — a country of 90 million people, a third of whom are employed directly or indirectly by the government and the security forces.

Haaretz Exposé: The plan to topple the Iranian regime was drawn up in just three months - Israel went to war unprepared | This week, we published an investigation - the deepest dive yet into Israel's plan to topple the Iranian regime and install Ahmadinejad as its new leader. On December 28, 2025, protests erupted in Tehran's Grand Bazaar over soaring inflation. Those protests, and the horrific massacre that followed, put Israel and the U.S. on the fast track to war with Iran. But contrary to what one might expect, neither the IDF nor the Israeli Mossad had war plans ready at the time. In early January, the prime minister summoned IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir and Mossad Director David Barnea for a situation assessment. He asked Zamir whether the military could prepare an attack plan on short notice. He asked Barnea whether the regime could actually be overthrown if the campaign began that winter. The Mossad was still far from having an operational plan to present, but the chief of staff was unequivocal. "We prioritize opportunity over readiness," Zamir said during a late-night consultation in January. "We knew we weren't ready," says a senior Mossad official. "But once Trump wanted to go to war, it was clear we were going for it." Netanyahu concluded the meeting by addressing the heads of the security establishment. To Zamir he said: "You will bring me the best attack plans you can develop." To Barnea: "You will bring me the best plan you can develop for toppling the regime." He ended the discussion with the words: "We'll do everything possible."

Saray, @DianaSaray ignoro cuántas personas han sido reparadas económicamente, pero el Acuerdo tenía varios pilares: verdad, justicia, reparación y garantías de no repetición. De lo que sí puede dar fe el país es de que militares han confesado miles de falsos positivos y excomandantes de las Farc han reconocido secuestros, reclutamiento y otros crímenes que durante décadas negaron. Esa verdad también es una forma de reparación para muchas víctimas. El Congreso dejó por fuera a terceros civiles y parapolíticos, una de las grandes falencias del sistema, y por eso el proceso quedó incompleto. Pero las verdades han hecho tanto daño colateral a la derecha que Duque y ADLE anuncian acabar la JEP. Duque no pudo, no sabemos si Abelardo lo logre. Sobre la No repetición, la mayoría ha cumplido. De los más de 20 congresistas que tuvieron las FARC solo uno regresó a la guerra. Y de los excombatientes, más del 80% se han mantenido al margen de la violencia. El Acuerdo es imperfecto y su implementación ha sido lento, pero afirmar que no sirvió para nada desconoce avances reales en verdad, justicia y reconocimiento de responsabilidades. Para muchas víctimas, eso también ha sido reparación. Pueda que esto sea poco para personas que no han sido afectadas por la violencia, pero para las víctimas es sanador. La paz perfecta no existe. Pero mil veces un Acuerdo imperfecto que una guerra perfecta y eterna. Saray, @DianaSaray ignoro cuántas personas han sido reparadas, pero el Acuerdo tenía varios pilares: verdad, justicia, reparación y garantías de no repetición. De lo que sí puede dar fe el país es de que militares han confesado miles de falsos positivos y excomandantes de las Farc han reconocido secuestros, reclutamiento y otros crímenes que durante décadas negaron. Esa verdad también es una forma de reparación para muchas víctimas. El Congreso dejó por fuera a terceros civiles y parapolíticos, una de las grandes falencias del sistema, y por eso el proceso quedó incompleto. Pero las verdades han hecho tanto daño colateral a la derecha que Duque y ADLE anuncian acabar la JEP. Duque no pudo, no sabemos si Abelardo lo logre. Sobre la No repetición, la mayoría ha cumplido. De los casi 30 congresistas que tuvieron las FARC solo uno regresó a la guerra. Y de los excombatientes, más del 80% se han mantenido al margen de la violencia. El Acuerdo es imperfecto y su implementación ha sido lento, pero afirmar que no sirvió para nada desconoce avances reales en verdad, justicia y reconocimiento de responsabilidades. Para muchas víctimas, eso también ha sido reparación. Pueda que esto sea poco para personas que no han sido afectadas por la violencia, pero para las víctimas es sanador. La paz perfecta no existe. Pero mil veces un Acuerdo imperfecto que una guerra perfecta y eterna. Diana Saray - EnLaDiana (@DianaSaray) He recibido muchos mensajes de quienes fueron parte de la construcción del Acuerdo de Paz insistiendo en que este fue un acuerdo que tuvo como eje a las víctimas. Sin embargo, hasta el día de hoy no he encontrado ninguna víctima de las Farc que se sienta reconocida con este acuerdo. Por eso quiero preguntar en esta red si hay aquí alguna víctima de las Farc que sienta que sí fue reparada y que en su caso se cumplieron las garantías de verdad, justicia y no repetición. India is set to witness a landmark moment in its space journey as #SkyrootAerospace #Vikram1, the country’s first privately developed orbital rocket, prepares for liftoff from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre, #Sriharikota, on July 18 under #MissionAagaman. The launch marks India’s entry into the private orbital launch era and a significant step forward for its commercial space ecosystem. ਜਲੰਧਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਸੰਤ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਨੂੰ ਮਿਲਣ ਦਾ ਸੁਭਾਗ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਹੋਇਆ। ਅਧਿਆਤਮਿਕ ਜਾਗਰੂਕਤਾ ਅਤੇ ਸਮਾਜ ਭਲਾਈ ਵਿੱਚ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦਾ ਯੋਗਦਾਨ ਬਹੁਤ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਰਨਾਦਾਇਕ ਹੈ।

ਪੰਜਾਬ ਨੂੰ ਸਾਫ਼-ਸੁਥਰੇ, ਇਮਾਨਦਾਰ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਕਾਸ-ਮੁਖੀ ਸ਼ਾਸਨ ਦੀ ਲੋੜ ਹੈ। ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਭਾਜਪਾ ਦੀ ਡਬਲ-ਇੰਜਣ ਸਰਕਾਰ ਹੀ ਨਵਾਂ ਨਿਵੇਸ਼ ਲਿਆ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ, ਰੁਜ਼ਗਾਰ ਪੈਦਾ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ, ਕਿਸਾਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਸ਼ਕਤ ਬਣਾ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ, ਔਰਤਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਸ਼ਕਤ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਇਹ ਯਕੀਨੀ ਬਣਾ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਪੰਜਾਬ ਵਿੱਚ ਬਣੇ ਉਤਪਾਦ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਭਰ ਦੇ ਬਾਜ਼ਾਰਾਂ ਤੱਕ ਪਹੁੰਚਣ।

ਪੰਜਾਬ ਕੋਲ ਬੇਮਿਸਾਲ ਸਮਰੱਥਾ ਹੈ। ਇੱਥੋਂ ਦੇ ਮਿਹਨਤੀ ਕਿਸਾਨ, ਹੁਨਰਮੰਦ ਨੌਜਵਾਨ, ਉੱਦਮੀ ਸੋਚ ਅਤੇ ਖੇਡਾਂ ਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਸੂਬੇ ਨੂੰ ਨਵੀਆਂ ਬੁਲੰਦੀਆਂ 'ਤੇ ਲੈ ਕੇ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੇ ਹਨ। ਦੁੱਖ ਦੀ ਗੱਲ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਮੌਜੂਦਾ ਸੂਬਾ ਸਰਕਾਰ ਨੇ ਵਿਗੜਦੀ ਅਮਨ-ਕਾਨੂੰਨ ਦੀ ਸਥਿਤੀ, ਨਸ਼ਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਖ਼ਤਰੇ, ਭ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟਾਚਾਰ, ਵਧਦੇ ਕਰਜ਼ੇ ਅਤੇ ਅਧੂਰੇ ਵਾਅਦਿਆਂ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਇਸ ਸਮਰੱਥਾ ਨਾਲ ਧੋਖਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ।

National Crime Agency (NCA) (@NCA_UK) Two young men have been sentenced for launching a cyber attack on Transport for London (TfL) which cost tens of millions of pounds in losses and inconvenienced thousands of customers. Thalha Jubair and Owen Flowers were identified by the NCA and @CityPolice following the attack on TfL’s network in 2024. Uttarakhand CMO says - "Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on Friday reviewed the preparations for the safe and peaceful conduct of the Shravan month Kanwar Yatra with police and administrative officials of the Meerut and Saharanpur divisions at the Mahatma Gandhi Auditorium, Collectorate. He issued clear instructions that no negligence in security, cleanliness, or traffic management would be tolerated during the yatra. He directed officials to take immediate and strict action against anti-social elements spreading rumours on social media and to promptly counter misleading information. The Chief Minister directed, "All concerned departments should complete their preparations before the commencement of the Kanwar Yatra. Adequate police personnel should be deployed along the entire yatra route. CCTV cameras should be installed at key locations, and continuous surveillance should be carried out through drones." He instructed the Divisional Commissioners of Meerut and Saharanpur to regularly review the preparations. CM Yogi Adityanath stated, "Continuous coordination should be maintained during the Kanwar Yatra with officials of neighbouring states, including Delhi, Uttarakhand, Haryana, Punjab, and Rajasthan, so that any situation can be handled effectively." He directed that the sound level of DJs should not exceed the prescribed limit and that the height of the Kanwars should also remain within the prescribed standards to ensure that traffic movement is not obstructed. He instructed officials to maintain continuous dialogue with DJ operators, Kanwar manufacturers, and Kanwar associations for this purpose. The Chief Minister directed the Public Works Department and the Irrigation Department to make the yatra routes pothole-free well in time and ensure the clearance of bushes. He said, "Cleanliness should be maintained throughout the entire route and that no garbage should be visible anywhere. Proper arrangements should be ensured at Kanwar camps for street lighting, drinking water, toilets, electricity, cleanliness, and fresh, satvik food." He issued clear instructions that all meat and liquor shops along the Kanwar Yatra route must remain closed and that continuous monitoring should be carried out to ensure compliance. The Transport Department was directed to ensure that no driver operates a vehicle under the influence of alcohol. The Power Department was instructed to closely monitor transformers and electricity lines to prevent any accidents. The Chief Minister directed officials to maintain continuous coordination with public representatives and ensure the immediate resolution of local issues. He also instructed that, with the support of the Information Department, welcome gates and hoardings should be installed for Kanwar pilgrims, and various public welfare schemes should be widely publicized. Senior administrative and police officials of the Meerut and Saharanpur divisions were present at the meeting."

Delhi Police say - Today, 17.07.26, information was received at 8:21 PM at PS New Usmanpur regarding the murder of a woman by her brother at Gali No. 17, Gautampuri. Police team immediately reached the spot, where a woman, identified as Waseema (32 years), w/o Irshad, was found lying with a gunshot injury. The Crime and Forensic Science teams inspected the scene and collected the relevant evidence. The body of the deceased was sent to Hospital for post-mortem examination. Accordingly, a case under Section 103(1) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) was registered at PS New Usmanpur, and investigation was taken up. Meanwhile, HC Nafish of PS Jafrabad, while on patrol duty in Gali No. 10, Chauhan Bangar, noticed a young man running in a suspicious manner and sweating profusely. Suspecting foul play, he intercepted and apprehended him. During his search, one country-made pistol along with six live cartridges was recovered from his possession. During initial interrogation, the apprehended person disclosed his identity as Md. Anas (19 years), s/o Md. Rafique. He further confessed that he had shot dead his sister, Waseema w/o Irshad, at Gali No. 17, Gautampuri. Accordingly, a separate case under Section 25 of the Arms Act was registered at PS Jafrabad. Subsequently, it was confirmed that the PCR call received at PS New Usmanpur pertained to the same incident. The accused has been arrested along with the suspected weapon used in the commission of the offence. One country-made pistol along with six live cartridges recovered. Further investigation in the case is in progress.

Acudo a este medio porque, hasta donde es de mi conocimiento, el Gobierno entrante aún no se ha posesionado y, en consecuencia, no existen canales institucionales plenamente habilitados que garanticen la radicación, el acuse de recibo y la respuesta a esta solicitud. Por ello utilizo este mismo medio, que ha sido empleado por usted para informar al país y a la comunidad internacional. Sus declaraciones realizadas en Washington, en las que afirmó que Colombia heredó una “patria miseria” y una “destrucción” de la economía, son de enorme trascendencia y pueden tener efectos sobre la percepción internacional del país. Por tal motivo, solicito respetuosamente que haga públicos los informes técnicos, actas de empalme, diagnósticos, inventarios, análisis fiscales y demás documentos que sustentan dichas afirmaciones. Esta solicitud es plenamente coherente con la Acción Popular que promoví para proteger la transparencia, el acceso a la información pública y la continuidad del proceso de empalme presidencial, proceso que actualmente continúa bajo el radicado No. 05001-23-33-000-2026-01054-00. Mi preocupación es que afirmaciones de esta magnitud, realizadas ante organismos internacionales, inversionistas y gobiernos extranjeros, puedan influir en decisiones de política económica o financiera sin que la ciudadanía conozca previamente la evidencia técnica que las respalda. Más aún cuando la información económica oficial disponible muestra un panorama que requiere un análisis técnico y no únicamente afirmaciones generales. El Banco de la República ha informado que el desempleo se ubicó alrededor del 8 % en mayo de 2026 y que el PIB continuó creciendo durante el primer trimestre, mientras que la inflación, aunque sigue siendo un desafío, cuenta con seguimiento permanente de la autoridad monetaria. संपन्न महाराष्ट्रासाठी उद्योग, गुंतवणूक आणि रोजगाराला बळ देणाऱ्या धोरणांची आखणी मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या अध्यक्षतेखाली आज वर्षा निवासस्थान, मुंबई येथे उद्योग विभागाची आढावा बैठक पार पडली. यावेळी राज्यातील औद्योगिक प्रगती, परकीय आणि देशांतर्गत गुंतवणुकीचे नियोजन, तसेच उद्योग क्षेत्रासाठी आवश्यक असलेल्या सेवांचा सविस्तर आढावा घेण्यात आला. देशात सर्वाधिक गुंतवणूक महाराष्ट्रात येत आहे. या गुंतवणुकीचे रूपांतर उद्योगांमध्ये करण्यासाठी गुंतवणूकक्षम आणि रोजगार निर्मितीची क्षमता असलेल्या क्षेत्रांसाठी सर्वंकष धोरणे आणावीत, तसेच सूक्ष्म, लघु व मध्यम उद्योगांचे सखोल सर्वेक्षण करून या क्षेत्राची उत्कृष्ट इकोसिस्टम निर्माण करण्याचे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी दिले. राज्याच्या उद्योगविश्वाच्या वाढीसाठी धोरण तयार करताना संबंधित क्षेत्रातील तज्ज्ञ, यशस्वी उद्योजक यांच्याशी चर्चा करावी. संबंधित उद्योग क्षेत्रातील कमतरता या धोरणांच्या माध्यमातून दूर करण्याचा प्रयत्न करण्यात यावा. तसेच सध्या अस्तित्वात असलेल्या विविध उद्योग विषयक धोरणांची प्रभावी अंमलबजावणी करावी, यामुळे संपन्न महाराष्ट्राची निर्मिती होईल असा विश्वासही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी व्यक्त केला. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, सूक्ष्म लघु व मध्यम उद्योगांमध्ये गुंतवणूकदार आणि उद्योजकांच्या आवश्यकतेनुसार क्षेत्रे निश्चित करावी. या क्षेत्रांच्या संभाव्यतेनुसार एमएसएमई उद्योगांच्या रोजगारनिर्मिती व उत्पादनक्षमतेमध्ये वाढ करावी. त्यासाठी विविध प्लॅटफॉर्म्स तयार करावीत. या क्षेत्राच्या सक्षमीकरणासाठी नवनवीन तंत्रज्ञान आणावे. हे सर्वाधिक रोजगारनिर्मिती करणारे क्षेत्र असल्यामुळे या क्षेत्राच्या विकासासाठी काम करावे. एमएसएमई उद्योगांचे सर्वेक्षण करताना त्यांची सद्यस्थिती, रोजगार निर्मितीची क्षमता, सध्या असलेली रोजगार निर्मिती आणि उत्पादन या सर्वांचा अभ्यास करण्यात यावा. मीडिया अँड अरेना धोरणामध्ये मोठी 'कन्व्हेन्शन सेंटर्स' उभारण्यासाठी व्यवसाय सुलभता असावी. यामुळे राज्यातील मोठ्या शहरांमध्ये 🚨BREAKING: ICE agents were filmed assaulting, handcuffing, and kidnapping a U.S. citizen in Passaic, New Jersey… while refusing to even look at the ID he repeatedly begged them to check. A man is pleading with federal agents to verify who he is… And they refused. Instead, one agent says, “We need to get him on the ground,” puts him in a chokehold, throws him to the ground, and multiple agents pile on top of him before handcuffing him, and throwing him into their vehicle. Under the Fourth Amendment, the government cannot arrest, or seize someone, without probable cause that they have committed, are committing, or are about to commit an offense that authorizes the arrest. U.S. citizens are also not required to carry identification unless they’re driving a motorized vehicle. And if federal agents are refusing to verify someone’s identity before arresting them, then they are openly ignoring the constitution. Which should terrify every American. Because that means no one is safe from being kidnapped by the government… and disappeared. Every agent involved should be publicly identified, and DHS should be forced to explain why they believed they had the legal authority to seize someone, while refusing to verify who he was. This cannot become normal. Video

यावेळी राज्यातील औद्योगिक प्रगती, परकीय आणि देशांतर्गत गुंतवणुकीचे नियोजन, तसेच उद्योग क्षेत्रासाठी आवश्यक असलेल्या सेवांचा सविस्तर आढावा घेण्यात आला. देशात सर्वाधिक गुंतवणूक महाराष्ट्रात येत आहे. या गुंतवणुकीचे रूपांतर उद्योगांमध्ये करण्यासाठी गुंतवणूकक्षम आणि रोजगार निर्मितीची क्षमता असलेल्या क्षेत्रांसाठी सर्वंकष धोरणे आणावीत, तसेच सूक्ष्म, लघु व मध्यम उद्योगांचे सखोल सर्वेक्षण करून या क्षेत्राची उत्कृष्ट इकोसिस्टम निर्माण करण्याचे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी दिले. राज्याच्या उद्योगविश्वाच्या वाढीसाठी धोरण तयार करताना संबंधित क्षेत्रातील तज्ज्ञ, यशस्वी उद्योजक यांच्याशी चर्चा करावी. संबंधित उद्योग क्षेत्रातील कमतरता या धोरणांच्या माध्यमातून दूर करण्याचा प्रयत्न करण्यात यावा. तसेच सध्या अस्तित्वात असलेल्या विविध उद्योग विषयक धोरणांची प्रभावी अंमलबजावणी करावी, यामुळे संपन्न महाराष्ट्राची निर्मिती होईल असा विश्वासही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी व्यक्त केला. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, सूक्ष्म लघु व मध्यम उद्योगांमध्ये गुंतवणूकदार आणि उद्योजकांच्या आवश्यकतेनुसार जलसमृद्ध महाराष्ट्रासाठी जलसंपदा प्रकल्पांच्या नियोजनबद्ध अंमलबजावणीवर भर मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या अध्यक्षतेखाली आज वर्षा निवासस्थान, मुंबई येथे जलसंपदा विभागाची केंद्र सरकार सहाय्यित योजना तसेच 'विकसित महाराष्ट्र 2047' उपक्रमाच्या सद्यस्थितीसंदर्भात आढावा बैठक पार पडली. राज्यातील सिंचन प्रकल्पांसाठी सरकार मोठ्या प्रमाणात तरतूद करत असून हे प्रकल्प वेळेत पूर्ण होण्यासाठी जलसंपदा विभागाने कार्यवाही करण्याचे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी दिले. या बैठकीत नारपार गिरणा नदीजोड प्रकल्प, दमणगंगा एकदरे गोदावरी, दमणगंगा वैतरणा गोदावरी, कोकण उल्हास - वैतरणा व गोदावरी खोरे नदीजोड प्रकल्प यांचा आढावा घेण्यात आला. राज्यात नदी जोड प्रकल्प, प्रधानमंत्री कृषी सिंचन योजना, बळीराजा जलसंजीवनी योजना यामधून अनेक प्रकल्प सुरू आहेत. राज्याच्या सिंचन व्यवस्थेमध्ये यामुळे मोठे बदल होणार आहे. विभागाने यासंदर्भात पारदर्शकपणे अंमलबजावणी करावी, असे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. वैनगंगा - नळगंगा नदीजोड प्रकल्पासह गोदावरी खोऱ्यातील वैनगंगा उपखोऱ्यातील 63.74 टीएमसी पाणी बुलढाणा जिल्ह्यातील नळगंगा उपखोऱ्यात वळविणे प्रस्तावित आहे. प्रकल्पाची सिंचनक्षमता 6,11,150 हेक्टर असून ते भंडारा, नागपूर, वर्धा, अमरावती, यवतमाळ, अकोला, बुलढाणा व वाशिम या 8 जिल्ह्यात विभागले आहे. प्रधानमंत्री कृषी सिंचन योजनेअंतर्गत राज्यातील योजनेतील 20 प्रकल्प पूर्ण झाले असून, 7 प्रकल्प प्रगतीपथावर आहेत. मार्च 2026 पर्यंत 4.30 लाख हेक्टर, म्हणजेच 74% सिंचन क्षमता निर्माण करण्यात यश आले आहे. यामध्ये 29 मोठे व मध्यम सिंचन प्रकल्पांचा समावेश करण्यात आला आहे. या प्रकल्पांची एकूण किंमत ₹24,721 कोटी असून, त्यासाठी ₹4288 कोटींच्या (17%) केंद्रीय सहाय्य आहे. या योजनेअंतर्गत 5.79 लाख हेक्टर अंतिम सिंचन क्षमता निर्माण करण्याचे उद्दिष्ट असून याचा यावेळी मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी आढावा घेतला. केंद्र शासनाने राज्यातील विदर्भ, मराठवाड्यातील अनेक जिल्ह्यात कृषी क्षेत्रातील संकटावर मात करण्यासाठी विशेष पॅकेज अंतर्गत बळीराजा जलसंजीवनी योजना सुरू केली. या योजनेत 8 मोठे व मध्यम सिंचन प्रकल्प तसेच 83 भूपृष्ठीय लघु सिंचन प्रकल्पांचा समावेश करण्यात आला आहे. यावेळी विकसित महाराष्ट्र अंतर्गत जलसंपदा विभागाकडून करण्यात येणारी कार्यवाहीबाबत माहिती देण्यात आली. यावेळी मंत्री राधाकृष्ण विखे पाटील, मंत्री गिरीष महाजन व वरिष्ठ अधिकारी उपस्थित होते. @Dev_Fadnavis @RVikhePatil @girishdmahajan #Maharashtra #DevendraFadnavis #WaterResources

क्वांटम तंत्रज्ञानात महाराष्ट्राचे नेतृत्व घडविण्यासाठी सक्षम इकोसिस्टीम उभारणार मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी आज वर्षा निवासस्थान, मुंबई येथे 'व्हिजन फॉर क्वांटम टेक्नोलॉजी इकोसिस्टम इन महाराष्ट्र' या विषयावर आयआयएसईआर, पुणे येथील क्वांटम टेक्नोलॉजी फॅकल्टी डेव्हलपमेंट कार्यक्रमाच्या समारोपप्रसंगी संबोधन केले (ऑनलाइन). कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता (एआय), सेमीकंडक्टर आणि क्वांटम तंत्रज्ञान हे भविष्यातील विकासाचे 3 प्रमुख आधारस्तंभ ठरणार आहेत. या क्षेत्रात महाराष्ट्राने मोठ्या प्रमाणावर कुशल मनुष्यबळ तयार करणे आवश्यक आहे. राष्ट्रीय क्वांटम मिशनशी सुसंगत असे महाराष्ट्र क्वांटम टेक्नॉलॉजी मिशन प्रभावीपणे राबवून राज्यात सक्षम क्वांटम इकोसिस्टीम उभारण्यात येईल, असे प्रतिपादन मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी केले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, जग अतिशय वेगाने बदलत असून डेटा-आधारित अर्थव्यवस्थेपासून आता उच्च गतीच्या डेटा प्रोसेसिंगच्या युगात प्रवेश होत आहे. भविष्यातील जागतिक स्पर्धेत एआय, सेमीकंडक्टर आणि क्वांटम तंत्रज्ञान निर्णायक भूमिका बजावणार आहेत. माहिती तंत्रज्ञान क्षेत्राप्रमाणेच क्वांटम क्षेत्रातही भारताने कुशल मनुष्यबळाच्या सामर्थ्यावर जागतिक नेतृत्व मिळविण्याची संधी साधली पाहिजे. केंद्र सरकारने राष्ट्रीय क्वांटम मिशनसाठी सुमारे ₹6000 कोटींची तरतूद केली आहे. त्याच धर्तीवर महाराष्ट्र शासन राज्याचे स्वतंत्र क्वांटम मिशन राबवत असून, प्रशिक्षित प्राध्यापकांच्या माध्यमातून राज्यात मजबूत क्वांटम इकोसिस्टीम उभारण्याचा प्रयत्न सुरू आहे. पुढील टप्प्यात 500 प्रशिक्षक आणि त्यानंतर किमान 5000 हून अधिक क्वांटम प्रशिक्षित मनुष्यबळ तयार करण्याचे उद्दिष्ट असल्याचेही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यावेळी म्हणाले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, क्वांटम तंत्रज्ञानामुळे अभियांत्रिकी, वैद्यकीय, अवकाश, उद्योग, संरक्षण अशा सर्वच क्षेत्रांत मोठी क्रांती होणार आहे. पुढील काही वर्षांत रोजगार क्षेत्राचे स्वरूप झपाट्याने बदलणार आहे. त्यामुळे विद्यार्थी आणि प्राध्यापकांना भविष्यातील तंत्रज्ञानासाठी आजपासूनच सक्षम करणे आवश्यक आहे. महाराष्ट्रात आयसर, सी-डॅक, टीआयएफआर, आयआयटी मुंबई, सीओईपी, व्हीएनआयटीसारख्या संस्थांमध्ये क्वांटम क्षेत्रातील क्षमता विकसित होत असून, या सर्व संस्थांची ताकद एकत्रित करून राज्याचे क्वांटम मिशन अधिक प्रभावीपणे पुढे नेण्यात येणार असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी सांगितले. प्रशिक्षणासाठी विकसित करण्यात आलेले अभ्यासक्रम, एलएमएस आणि 'चंद्र' व 'सूर्य' हे चॅटबॉट्स India's female workforce participation rate among women (15+) has climbed markedly, from 19.2% in 2017–18 to 32.5% in 2025. While this expansion represents a genuine advance on the extensive margin, the terms on which women are engaged raise persistent concerns about the depth and quality of their labour market engagement. PLFS data shows that irrespective of broad sectors like agriculture, industry, or services, female employment remains located in low-productivity activities, within very small or informal enterprises, frequently in unpaid capacities in crop production and livestock; wearing apparel, textiles, tobacco manufacturing, and domestic services. Work in these segments is often part-time, supplementary, or organised on a piece-rate basis, captured through lower working hours, arrangements that constrain earnings, foreclose career progression, and no social security protection. In contrast, women remain underrepresented in high-value, knowledge-intensive industries such as scientific R&D, computer programming and consultancy, management consultancy, and legal and accounting services, those sectors that pair higher hourly wages with stable, full-time employment. Education and human health services stand out as partial exceptions, absorbing comparatively large numbers of women at earnings and hours close to the economy-wide average; yet even these sectors occupy the middle rather than the upper reaches of the distribution. The overall picture, therefore, is one of broad but shallow inclusion. While the rising share of women in the workforce is a positive development, much of this increase has been concentrated at the lower end of the labour market rather than in its most productive and remunerative segments. Expanding women's participation is therefore only the first step; equal attention must be paid to improving the quality of employment. This requires proactive measures to facilitate women's entry into higher-productivity, better-paying, and formal jobs through enterprise formalisation, expanded social protection, and improved access to finance, enabling their transition from unpaid and informal work into stable wage employment. At the same time, policy efforts should focus on increasing women's representation in emerging "future of work" sectors through targeted skilling initiatives, apprenticeships, and stronger industry partnerships. Finally, enabling women to participate fully in the labour market will require addressing persistent structural barriers by expanding affordable childcare, ensuring safe and reliable transport, and promoting flexible work arrangements. Important reports from combat commanders on the situation in the most intense directions. Today, I spoke with Commander of the Unmanned Systems Forces of the Armed Forces of Ukraine Robert Brovdi, Commander of the 1st Corps Azov of the National Guard of Ukraine Denys Prokopenko, Commander of the 2nd Corps Khartiia of the National Guard of Ukraine Ihor Obolenskyi, Deputy Commander of the Airborne Assault Forces of the Armed Forces of Ukraine Andrii Tkachuk, and Interim Commander of the 19th Army Corps of the Operational Command South of the Land Forces of the Armed Forces of Ukraine Valerii Skred. I am grateful to everyone for the tangible results delivered for Ukraine. The commanders reported on the frontline situation, the destruction of the occupier's forces, and the key aspects of supplying our units. Ukraine's defense remains active, and assigned objectives in the directions are being carried out in full. We focused on the need for a larger-scale supply of drones used at operational depth. We also discussed the challenges of producing and supplying fiber-optic drones. The success of the program for the fair distribution of personnel among combat brigades was recognized. The program has been in place since December of last year and will continue. Khartiia's unique experience in recruiting foreign volunteers to defend Ukraine should be expanded to other units as well, and we discussed what is needed to make that happen. I am grateful to the Commander of Azov for the special attention he is giving to the prisoner exchanges and the fate of our prisoners of war. Appropriate instructions will be issued based on today's discussion. I also want to specifically commend the units of the Airborne Assault Forces for their effectiveness in carrying out our active defense. And, of course, my thanks to the Unmanned Systems Forces for their precision! We are preparing a special Staff meeting with the participation of corps commanders and the leading manufacturers of the weapons and equipment currently needed on the front line. Glory to Ukraine!

A statue honouring Alfred Dreyfus has been given a permanent home outside the Cour de cassation in Paris, the court that finally overturned the Jewish army officer’s wrongful conviction for treason in 1906. The unveiling took place on France’s national day of remembrance for Dreyfus, established last year to honour his legacy and the values of justice, equality and truth. The Dreyfus Affair remains one of the most infamous examples of antisemitism in modern European history. Falsely accused in 1894 of passing military secrets to Germany, Dreyfus was publicly humiliated, stripped of his rank and sentenced to life imprisonment. His case exposed deep antisemitic prejudices within French society and became a global symbol of the fight against injustice. The statue’s new location outside France’s highest court is a powerful reminder that truth can prevail over hatred, even after years of persecution and denial.

اسلام آباد: 17 جولائی 2026۔ وزیرِ اعظم محمد شہباز شریف سے "اُڑان اوورسیز پاکستان سمر اسکالرز پروگرام" کے اسکالرز کی اسلام آباد میں ملاقات ہوئی. اسکالرز وزارتِ منصوبہ بندی و ترقیات کے تحت پاکستان کو درپیش مسائل پر تحقیق کے لیے چھ ہفتوں کی انٹرن شپ کر رہے ہیں. وزیرِ اعظم نے دنیا کی ممتاز جامعات میں زیرِ تعلیم پاکستانی طلبہ کا پاکستان میں انٹرنشپ کے فیصلے کا خیرمقدم کیا. وزیرِ اعظم نے اسکالرز کو حکومت کے اصلاحاتی ایجنڈے پر بریفنگ دی اور انکے سوالات کے جوابات دیے. گفتگو کرتے ہوئے وزیرِ اعظم نے کہا کہ قومی ترقی میں نوجوانوں کا کلیدی کردار ہے. پوری دنیا میں آج پاکستانی طلباء و طالبات ملک کا نام روشن کر رہے ہیں. ماضی میں جب ملک ڈیفالٹ کے دہانے پر پہنچ چکا تھا تب ہنگامی معاشی اصلاحات کے ذریعے استحکام کا حصول ممکن ہوا. جامع اصلاحات میں ایف بی آر کی ڈیجیٹائز یشن اور محاصل میں اضافہ، کاروبار میں آسانی، پیداواری صلاحیت میں اضافہ، زرعی شعبے کی ترقی، نوجوانوں کو بااختیار بنانا، قابل تجدید توانائی کا فروغ اور پائیدار معاشی ترقی سمیت اصلاحات شامل ہیں. مؤثر انفورسمنٹ اقدامات کے نتیجے میں گزشتہ مالی سال کے دوران ایف بی آر نے 800 ارب روپے سے زائد اضافی محصولات جمع کیں. وزیرِ اعظم نے مزید کہا کہ حکومت کی معاشی اصلاحات کا مقصد مضبوط، خود کفیل اور برآمدات پر مبنی معیشت کی بنیاد رکھنا ہے. فیلڈ مارشل کی قیادت اور قوم کی بھرپور حمایت سے پاکستان نے مئی 2025 میں بھارت کو شکست دی. امریکہ اور ایران کے درمیان جاری جنگ رکوانے میں پاکستان کی ثالثی کا کردار پاکستان کی سفارتی تاریخ کا ایک نمایاں باب ہے. پاکستان کی سفارتی کاوشوں کے نتیجے میں اسلام آباد مفاہمتی یادداشت (Islamabad MoU) طے پائی، جو عالمی امن کے لیے ایک اہم پیش رفت ہے. وزیرِ اعظم نے اسکالرز پر زور دیا کہ وہ اپنی تعلیم، تحقیق اور عالمی تجربے کو پاکستان کی ترقی اور خوشحالی کے لیے بروئے کار لائیں۔ اجلاس میں طلباء و طالبات نے مختلف شعبوں میں بہتری کے حوالے سے اپنے خیالات کا اظہار کیا. اجلاس میں وفاقی وزراء احسن اقبال، عطا اللہ تارڑ، علی پرویز ملک، وزیر مملکت برائے خزانہ بلال اظہر کیانی, وزیر مملکت برائے قومی تعلیم و پیشہ ورانہ تربیت وجیحہ قمر اور متعلقہ اداروں کے اعلیٰ افسران شریک تھے۔ Video

Another milestone in preserving India’s rich ancient heritage! An MoU was signed between the Gyan Bharatam Mission and the Shri Maharaja Ranbir Singh Sanskrit Research Institute, historically known as the Raghunath Temple Sanskrit Manuscript Library, Jammu, Jammu & Kashmir. The MoU was exchanged between Dr. Karan Singh, a prolific author and former Member of Parliament, and Shri Vivek Aggarwal, Secretary, Ministry of Culture, today in New Delhi. Established in the 19th century by Maharaja Ranbir Singh, the institute is one of India’s premier centres dedicated to the preservation and research of rare Sanskrit and Sharda-script manuscripts. It houses an invaluable collection of over 6,000 rare manuscripts and 20,000+ traditional books, making it a significant repository of India’s knowledge traditions. Shri Samar Nanda, Joint Secretary, Ministry of Culture; Shri Inderjeet Singh, Director, Ministry of Culture; Dr. Anirban Dash, Project Director, Gyan Bharatam Mission; and other dignitaries were also present on the occasion. #GyanBharatam #CultureUnitesAll

'वर्ल्ड ऑडिओ व्हिज्युअल अँड एंटरटेनमेंट समिट (वेव्ह्स) 2027' म्हणजेच जागतिक दर्जाच्या वेव्ह्स परिषदेच्या तयारीला आतापासूनच वेग देत कार्यक्रमाचे नियोजन, विभागनिहाय जबाबदाऱ्या, अर्थसंकल्प, प्रसिद्धी, वाहतूक, तांत्रिक व्यवस्था आणि विविध समन्वयाच्या बाबी वेळेत पूर्ण कराव्यात. वेव्ह्स 2027 अधिक व्यापक, सुटसुटीत आणि प्रभावी आयोजन करण्यावर भर द्यावा, तसेच परिषदेच्या नियोजनात कोणतीही कमतरता राहणार नाही याची काळजी घ्यावी, असे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. पहिल्या वेव्ह्स परिषदेने जागतिक स्तरावर प्रभावी छाप निर्माण केली असून महाराष्ट्राच्या ब्रँड मूल्यामध्ये भर पडली आहे. त्यामुळे पुढील आवृत्ती अधिक भव्य आणि दर्जेदार करण्यासाठी नियोजनबद्ध तयारी आवश्यक आहे. हवामानाचा विचार करून परिषद फेब्रुवारी किंवा मार्चमध्ये घेण्याचा प्रयत्न करावा, असेही निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. परिषदेसाठी जबाबदाऱ्या निश्चित करून प्रत्येक कामासाठी निश्चित कालमर्यादा ठरवावी व कार्यक्रमस्थळाचे योग्य नियोजन करावे. तसेच उभारणी, ब्रँडिंग, तांत्रिक सुविधा, प्रोटोकॉल, वाहतूक, प्रसिद्धी आणि जनसंपर्क यामध्ये कोणतीही त्रुटी राहणार नाही, याची दक्षता घेण्याचे निर्देशही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी दिले. बैठकीत माहिती व प्रसारण मंत्रालय आणि महाराष्ट्र शासन यांच्यातील समन्वय अधिक बळकट करण्यासाठी सामंजस्य करार, संयुक्त समन्वय समिती, भागीदारी मॉडेल आणि उद्योग क्षेत्राचा अधिकाधिक सहभाग वाढविण्याबाबत चर्चा झाली. तसेच एव्हीजीसी क्षेत्रात अधिक गुंतवणूक आकर्षित करण्यासाठी परिषदेचा प्रभावी वापर करण्यावरही भर देण्यात आला. यासोबतच परिषदेच्या आयोजनासाठी तांत्रिक पायाभूत सुविधा, मोबाईल आधारित नोंदणी प्रणाली, एकात्मिक डिजिटल प्लॅटफॉर्म, आंतरराष्ट्रीय प्रतिनिधींसाठी स्वतंत्र प्रोटोकॉल व्यवस्था, प्रसिद्धी आणि जनसंपर्कासाठी राष्ट्रीय व आंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तरावरील धोरण राबविण्याचे आणि नियोजन करण्याचे निर्देशही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. यावेळी वरिष्ठ अधिकारी उपस्थित होते. @Dev_Fadnavis @WAVESummitIndia #Maharashtra #DevendraFadnavis #WAVES2027

احسان‌الله کامگار، سخن‌گوی فرماندهی امنیه‌ی طالبان در بدخشان حمله‌ به مرکز ولسوالی یفتل پایین را تأیید کرد. او در پیام صوتی که از سوی تلویزیون طلوع‌نیوز منتشر شده است، عاملان حمله را افراد «غیرمسئول» عنوان می‌کند. کامگار می‌گوید که این حمله زمانی انجام شده است که مقام‌های محلی طالبان بخاطر رخصتی جمعه به خانه‌های شان رفته بودند. به گفته‌ی او، افراد مسلح پس از رسیدن نیروهای طالبان، از ساحه متواری شده‌اند. بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/257500

احسان‌الله کامگار، سخنگوی قوماندانی امنیهٔ ولایت بدخشان می‌گوید که پس از نشر گزارش‌هایی مبنی بر سقوط ولسوالی «یفتل پایین» در ولایت بدخشان، فصیح‌الدین فطرت، لوی درستیز امارت اسلامی، به این ولسوالی سفر کرده و گفته است که بیشتر اغتشاش‌گران بازداشت شده‌اند و افراد باقی‌مانده آنان نیز به‌زودی دستگیر خواهند شد. او تأکید کرده که هیچ‌گونه مشکل امنیتی در بدخشان وجود ندارد و هر فردی که بخواهد امنیت این ولایت را برهم بزند، با برخورد قاطع نیروهای امنیتی مواجه خواهد شد. فطرت افزوده است که جوانان باید با نیروهای امنیتی کشور همکاری کنند و فریب کسانی را نخورند که از افغانستان فرار کرده‌اند.

احسان‌الله کامگار سخنگوی قوماندانی امنیهٔ ولایت بدخشان می‌گوید: «در ولسوالۍ یفتل ولایت شب جمعه چون مسئولین درجه اول ولسوالی در رخصتی بودند تعداد از افراد غیرمسئول و مغرض بر مقر ولسوالی حمله کردند که در ظرف چند ساعت با رسیدن نیروهای امنیتی به منطقه پس رانده شدند تعداد شان گرفتار شدند و چند تن شان که متواری هستن عملیات جستجو آنها هم جریان دارد.» او نوشته است که تا پایان روز همه انها «به جزای بغاوت و سرکشی شان خواهد رسیدند.»

Is India's ethanol blending programme energy security — or a new form of dependency? In the latest episode of @ThePrintIndia Uninterrupted, Prof. Ashok Gulati (@agulati115), ICRIER, speaks on India reaching 20% ethanol blending years ahead of schedule, and what that milestone really signals. The conversation examines whether the shift from sugarcane to maize-based ethanol genuinely reduces India's dependence on the world, or simply moves it from the oil import bill to a food and fertiliser one. It also turns to the distorted NPK fertiliser ratio now visible in states like Punjab and Haryana, the risk a weak monsoon poses to scaling blending further, and whether the programme is, at its core, a farm-income scheme in the language of energy security. A French traveler has gone viral after checking a Chinese-made air conditioner as luggage on his flight back to #Europe, as soaring temperatures drive strong demand for #cooling appliances across the continent. The story was shared by a Chinese netizen, who said the French man learned during a business trip to Shanghai that his 93-year-old mother in Paris was struggling with the heat and relying on a fan with ice to cool down. Colleagues suggested buying an air conditioner in #China and taking it home. After confirming the airline's baggage rules, he successfully checked in the unit. Traveling in business class with a sufficient baggage allowance, he only paid for packaging. The total cost came to 1,412 yuan, and he has since arrived safely in Barcelona, Spain, with the air conditioner. Europe has been hit by another round of extreme heat, prompting a surge in demand for cooling products. According to #Joybuy, JD's global online site, air conditioner sales rose nearly 40-fold between June 19 and 25 compared with the first week of June. Official data showed China exported 107.91 billion yuan worth of cooling appliances, including air conditioners, electric fans and refrigerators, in the first half of the year, helping bring relief to households around the world amid rising temperatures.

اسلام آباد: 17 جولائی 2026. وزیرِ اعظم محمد شہباز شریف کی زیر صدارت کاروبار میں آسانی کیلئے اقدامات پر جائزہ اجلاس آج اسلام آباد میں منعقد ہوا. اجلاس سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے وزیرِ اعظم نے کہا کہ کاروبار میں آسانی کیلئے حکومت کے پالیسی اقدامات اور آسان کاروبار ایکٹ 2025 کے نفاذ میں تیزی لائی جائے. کاروبار میں آسانی کے اقدامات کی افادیت اور نفاذ کی جانچ کیلئے بین الاقوامی اداروں سے تھرڈ پارٹی ویلیڈیشن یقینی بنائی جائے. پاکستان میں مقامی و بیرونی سرمایہ کاری کی وسیع استعداد سے بھرپور فائدہ اٹھانا حکومت کی اولین ترجیحات میں شامل ہے. وزیرِ اعظم نے مزید کہا کہ کاروبار میں آسانی کیلئے پالیسی اقدامات کے نفاذ پر جامع رپورٹ مرتب کرکے جلد پیش کی جائے. کاروبار میں آسانی کیلئے قانون و پالیسی سازی پر وزرات قانون و انصاف، ایس آئی ایف سی، سرمایہ کاری بورڈ، وزارت کامرس، وزارت صنعت اور تمام متعلقہ اداروں کی کاوشیں لائق تحسین ہیں. اجلاس کو اقدامات کے نفاذ پر جائرے اور آئندہ کے لائحہ عمل پر بریفنگ دی گئی. اجلاس کو بتایا گیا کہ ملک میں کاروبار میں آسانی کیلئے مختلف ضوابط اور کاغذی کاروائیوں و منظوریوں کو کم کرنے کے حوالے سے 558 اصلاحات پر کام مکمل ہو چکا جس میں سے 71 پالیسی اقدامات کا نفاذ ہو چکا جبکہ 272 کے نفاذ پر کام تیزی سے جاری ہے. 7 مرحلوں میں مختلف شعبوں میں ان کا نفاذ کیا جارہا ہے. ان اقدامات کی بدولت کاروباری برادری کو مختلف ضابطوں و شرائط پر خرچ ہونے والی بچت کی رقم کا تخمینہ 468.7 ارب روپے ہے. اجلاس کو مزید بتایا گیا کہ غیر ضروری و پیچیدہ کاغذی کاروائی اور ضوابط کے خاتمے سے برآمدات میں اضافہ، براہ راست بیرونی سرمایہ کاری میں اضافہ، روزگار کے نئے مواقع پیدا ہونگے. وزیرِ اعظم نے ہدایت کی کہ متعلقہ اداروں کے افسران کی کارکردگی کی جانچ میں انکی جانب سے کاروبار میں آسانی کے اقدامات کے نفاذ اور اسکی وجہ سے پیدا ہونے والے روزگار کے مواقع کو کلیدی اہمیت دی جائے. اجلاس میں وفاقی وزراء اعظم نذیر تارڑ، قیصر احمد شیخ، جام کمال خان، احد خان چیمہ، سید مصطفی کمال، وزیرِ مملکت بلال اظہر کیانی، مشیر وزیرِ اعظم محمد علی، معاون خصوصی ہارون اختر، اٹارنی جنرل منصور اعوان اور متعلقہ اعلی حکام نے شرکت کی. اجلاس میں گورنر اسٹیٹ بینک جمیل احمد، گلگت بلتستان اور آزاد کشمیر سمیت چاروں صوبوں کے چیف سیکریٹریز اور بین الاقوامی شہرت یافتہ شعبے کے ماہرین نے ویڈیو لنک کے ذریعے شرکت کی. America, from space. 🛰️ To celebrate America's 250th anniversary, the USGS has created a new portrait of the nation using imagery from Landsat 8 and Landsat 9. For more than 50 years, the @USGS and @NASA Landsat program has provided a continuous record of Earth's changing land surface. This new mosaic showcases the incredible diversity of the United States, from the rainforests of the Pacific Northwest to the Everglades of Florida, from the Rocky Mountains to the agricultural heartland of the Great Plains. It also continues a tradition that began in 1976, when Landsat imagery was used to create "Portrait U.S.A." for the nation's bicentennial. Learn more about this image (also available as a poster) and download a free high-resolution copy 👉ow.ly/hLPn50ZjKhS 📷: Landsat Portrait of America, created using imagery from Landsat 8 and Landsat 9 and elevation data from the USGS National Elevation Dataset.

IFAD has launched a new project to raise incomes, strengthen resilience to climate shocks and improve access to nutritious food for rural families in Afghanistan. Implemented by the Dutch Committee for Afghanistan (DCA), the Crisis Response Initiative Supplementary Financing (CRISF) will reach about 425,000 people across 13 provinces. The project builds on IFAD’s earlier Crisis Response Initiative and the Rural Poor Stimulus Facility (2021–2024), which reached more than 175,000 households. A 2024 assessment found that among participating households: 🔹 96% reported higher incomes 🔹 64% reported improved market sales 🔹 90% said the project helped them cope with climate and economic shocks CRISF will build on these gains while addressing the challenges that threaten them. With three-quarters of Afghanistan’s population dependent on livestock and subsistence farming, the project will invest in pasture and watershed management, livestock water points, and small-scale irrigation to help protect communities from drought and flooding. It will also expand access to finance through microfinance institutions, helping farmers and small enterprises grow. Read more at bit.ly/4vEzkXo #IFADImpact #FinancingTheFirstMile

PAKISTAN: Sanitation workers keep our cities running, yet many continue to work in conditions that put their lives at risk. On 4 July, two sanitation workers died and another was critically injured after inhaling toxic gases while cleaning a manhole in Chishtian, Punjab. Their deaths are the latest in a series of preventable tragedies involving sanitation workers carrying out dangerous sewer-cleaning work without adequate protection. Based on media reports, at least 16 sanitation workers have died since April 2026. Their deaths were linked to suffocation and exposure to toxic fumes while manually cleaning sewers. The dangers sanitation workers face extend beyond sewer cleaning. On 1 June, a sanitation worker was crushed to death while sweeping a road. Days later, another sanitation worker set himself on fire in Gujranwala after allegedly facing unpaid wages and unlawful salary deductions. He died from his injuries on 28 June. Reports indicate that he had repeatedly raised concerns about insufficient wages before his death.

Tariffs are back, industrial policy is fashionable again, and over the past year the United States, the country that helped build and maintain the open trading system, has spent its energy tearing holes in it, taxing allies and rivals alike. The popular verdict in India is grim: a global trade war is on, the rules-based order is finished, and we are caught in the crossfire. But is that really what's happening? In this episode of Turbulence, Anupam Manur (@anupammanur) is joined by Devashish Mitra (@DevashishMitra_), Professor of Economics at Syracuse University's Maxwell School, and the economist who has written extensively on the political economy of trade policy. His answer is bracing on two counts. Tariffs, he argues, can't do what they promise: trade balances are governed by macroeconomics, not trade policy, and the cost of a tariff falls largely on the country that imposes it. And for India, the more uncomfortable truth is that the binding constraint was never Washington, but it's India's own protectionism. The conversation runs from Trump's tariffs to the wider drift toward industrial policy and "friend-shoring," to what the future of trade might look like and what India should actually do about it. India's female workforce participation rate among women (15+) has climbed markedly, from 19.2% in 2017–18 to 32.5% in 2025. While this expansion represents a genuine advance on the extensive margin, the terms on which women are engaged raise persistent concerns about the depth and quality of their labour market engagement. PLFS data shows that irrespective of broad sectors like agriculture, industry, or services, female employment remains located in low-productivity activities, within very small or informal enterprises, frequently in unpaid capacities in crop production and livestock; wearing apparel, textiles, tobacco manufacturing, and domestic services. Work in these segments is often part-time, supplementary, or organised on a piece-rate basis, captured through lower working hours, arrangements that constrain earnings, foreclose career progression, and no social security protection. In contrast, women remain underrepresented in high-value, knowledge-intensive industries such as scientific R&D, computer programming and consultancy, management consultancy, and legal and accounting services, those sectors that pair higher hourly wages with stable, full-time employment. Education and human health services stand out as partial exceptions, absorbing comparatively large numbers of women at earnings and hours close to the economy-wide average; yet even these sectors occupy the middle rather than the upper reaches of the distribution. The overall picture, therefore, is one of broad but shallow inclusion. While the rising share of women in the workforce is a positive development, much of this increase has been concentrated at the lower end of the labour market rather than in its most productive and remunerative segments. Expanding women's participation is therefore only the first step; equal attention must be paid to improving the quality of employment. This requires proactive measures to facilitate women's entry into higher-productivity, better-paying, and formal jobs through enterprise formalisation, expanded social protection, and improved access to finance, enabling their transition from unpaid and informal work into stable wage employment. At the same time, policy efforts should focus on increasing women's representation in emerging "future of work" sectors through targeted skilling initiatives, apprenticeships, and stronger industry partnerships. Finally, enabling women to participate fully in the labour market will require addressing persistent structural barriers by expanding affordable childcare, ensuring safe and reliable transport, and promoting flexible work arrangements. Lazaro, Chair of the ASEAN Foreign Ministers’ Meeting (AMM) 2026 and Secretary of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of the Philippines, Secretary-General of ASEAN Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, will lead the ASEAN Secretariat’s delegation to participate in the 59th ASEAN Foreign Ministers’ Meeting, the ASEAN Post-Ministerial Conferences, the 27th ASEAN Plus Three Foreign Ministers’ Meeting, the 16th East Asia Summit Foreign Ministers’ Meeting, the 33rd ASEAN Regional Forum, and the meeting of the Southeast Asia Nuclear Weapon-Free Zone (SEANWFZ) Commission. The series of meetings hosted by the Philippines, as ASEAN Chair for 2026, will take place in Manila, the Philippines, on 18-24 July 2026, under the theme “Navigating Our Future, Together.” While in Manila, Dr. Kao will hold bilateral meetings with Foreign Ministers from ASEAN Member States and ASEAN’s external partners to explore ways to further strengthen ASEAN’s cooperation and partnership in support of the implementation of ASEAN 2045: Our Shared Future. Dr. Kao is also scheduled to hold an interface with the ASEAN Intergovernmental Commission on Human Rights (AICHR) Representatives on the margins of the 59th AMM and Related Meetings. Concluding the series of meetings, Dr. Kao will participate in the commemorative activities marking the 50th anniversary of the Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in Southeast Asia (TAC) on 24 July 2026, including the high-level Conference of the High Contracting Parties to the TAC, the signing ceremony for new High Contracting Parties to the TAC, and the Gala Dinner to be hosted by H.E. Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr., President of the Republic of the Philippines and ASEAN Chair for 2026.

POR QUÉ LA DERROTA ANTE ARGENTINA FUE “LA MÁS DOLOROSA EN 60 AÑOS DE SUFRIMIENTO”, SEGÚN UN PRESTIGIOSO MEDIO INGLÉS La eliminación de Inglaterra a manos de Argentina en la semifinal del Mundial dejó una huella difícil de borrar en la memoria colectiva del fútbol británico. El equipo europeo, que soñaba con romper una sequía de seis décadas sin alcanzar la gloria máxima, vio cómo esa oportunidad se desvanecía en los últimos minutos de un partido cargado de emociones y decisiones polémicas. La pregunta que se debatió el medio BBC Sport tras el pitido final fue sencilla pero profunda: “¿Por qué la derrota de Inglaterra ante Argentina se sintió como la más dolorosa en 60 años de sufrimiento?”. En el análisis publicado por Phil McNulty, redactor jefe de fútbol americano en Atlanta, se abordó de frente esta cuestión. Según su perspectiva, “Inglaterra ha sufrido mucho a lo largo de los años, pero como observador que cubrió su séptimo Mundial, así como aquellas derrotas en las finales de la Eurocopa, esta se sintió como la peor”. La afirmación no es menor: la sensación de haber estado tan cerca y, aun así, volver a tropezar, caló hondo en el ánimo de jugadores y simpatizantes. El contexto de la derrota se agrava porque, más allá de la caída frente a un rival histórico, lo que más pesó fue la certeza de que la semifinal representaba una oportunidad inmejorable. “Dadas las circunstancias, esta es una derrota que se analizará con más detenimiento, que generará más pesar, que cualquier otra”, concluyó McNulty. 📲 Leé la nota completa 🔗 infob.ae/4bMw4lw

Rekha Gupta, Delhi has taken a historic step towards citizen-first governance with the approval of the Delhi (Right of Citizen to Time Bound and Ease of Delivery of Services) Bill, 2026. The new law gives every citizen a legal right to receive notified government services within a fixed timeline, making governance faster, simpler, more transparent and accountable. Time-bound service delivery, automatic escalation of delayed cases, an independent grievance redressal mechanism, a Right to Service Commission and penalties for negligence will ensure that citizens receive the services they are entitled to without unnecessary delays. #ViksitDelhi Video

STORY | US introduces fixed-term for student, exchange visas The US on Thursday tightened the rules governing visas for foreign students, exchange visitors and journalists, ending the old regime that allowed them to stay in the country indefinitely without government oversight. The new regulation establishes a fixed period of admission for non-immigrant visa holders in F, J, and I classifications, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) said in a statement here. The F category visas are for students, the J category for exchange visitors, and the I category is for journalists. Non-immigrant students (F visas) and exchange visitors (J visas) will be admitted for the length of their specific programme, not to exceed a maximum period of four years, the DHS said in a statement. “For decades, foreign students have been admitted into the US indefinitely, allowing thousands to abuse our immigration system by perpetually enrolling in courses to avoid having to leave the US,” DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin said in a statement here. Хтось боїться за свій підрозділ, розуміючи, що після відвертої оцінки дій Головнокомандувача його людей можуть спрямувати на провальний напрямок або залишити без належного забезпечення. Замовчування реального стану справ сьогодні створює загрозу для всієї країни. Ви складали присягу українському народові. Ваші командири несуть відповідальність за вас, за ваші життя і за боєздатність своїх підрозділів. Саме тому їхня чесність перед Верховним Головнокомандувачем є частиною цієї відповідальності. Допоможіть своїм командирам зробити цей крок. Допоможіть їм сказати правду. Від їхньої сміливості та вашої позиції залежить майбутнє України.

With its strikes on Moscow, Ukraine is taking disruption to a new level. The success of a long-range strike is not measured by impact alone. Even an intercepted attack closes airspace, disrupts flights and logistics, and erodes the sense of security. Russia cannot protect everything. It has more targets than air defences. Hitting the target magnifies the effect, but disruption begins before destruction. Yes, Russia will continue firing ballistic missiles at Ukrainian cities. But Putin’s problem is that Ukrainian suffering will no longer compensate Russians for disruption at home. As that disruption spreads, Russians will increasingly blame Putin and his corrupt regime for breaking the central bargain underpinning his rule since 2022: war was supposed to be something Ukrainians suffer, not them. The choice is Putin’s: wind down the war to preserve control, or tighten control at home to keep the war going. I would love to be wrong, but everything we know about him suggests he will choose the latter.

I requested either a replacement vehicle, since no permanent solution was being found, or a refund. Both the company and the showroom flatly refused. ⚡️The three circles belong to one war system. Hormuz, Bab el-Mandeb, and the eastern Mediterranean are the valves controlling the region’s movement of oil, gas, weapons, capital, shipping, data, and political influence. Whoever controls the valves controls the price of access. Whoever can threaten them cheaply can extract concessions far beyond their conventional military strength. The future fight is over route sovereignty. The United States and Gulf states are building redundancy through pipelines, ports, protected sea lanes, new insurance structures, Mediterranean outlets, military escorts, and governments tied into the same commercial architecture. Israel attacks the Iranian networks capable of sabotaging that system. Turkey competes to route the northern branch through territory it can influence. Oman gains power by administering the passage rules. Iraq and Syria become the land bridge whose alignment determines whether Gulf energy can reach the Mediterranean without Iranian permission. Iran’s answer is distributed veto power. Mines at Hormuz. Houthis near Bab el-Mandeb. Militias across Iraq. Hezbollah and remnants across the Levant. Drones against pumping stations. Missiles against ports. Cyberattacks against logistics. One cheap weapon can raise the cost of an entire corridor because insurers and shipowners react before governments establish attribution. That is the decisive asymmetry. A state must defend thousands of miles of infrastructure continuously. A proxy needs one successful strike. The next regional order will therefore be armed infrastructure. Pipelines guarded like borders. Ports treated like military bases. Shipping lanes administered through permits and surveillance. Insurance backed by governments. Air defenses protecting commercial corridors. Proxy attacks used as price signals during negotiations. Peace will exist as managed throughput. Ships will move. Oil will flow. Governments will announce stability. Underneath, every route will remain protected, contested, and priced for attack. The image gets one thing wrong. The Mediterranean circle is too small. The real third chokepoint is the entire Levantine corridor from Iraq through Syria, Jordan, Turkey, Lebanon, Israel, and Cyprus. Its value comes from turning Gulf and Iraqi resources westward while bypassing Hormuz and parts of the Red Sea. That is why Syria’s alignment, Iraqi militia control, Lebanese disarmament, Turkish influence, Israeli security policy, and Gulf reconstruction money all belong to the same strategic contest. The deepest pattern is now visible: Washington is building a corridor lattice that reduces Iran’s geographic leverage. Iran is building a sabotage lattice that makes every alternative corridor expensive. This will define the region for the next decade. The winner will be the side that can keep commerce moving at lower total security cost. Military victories matter only when they change that equation. The final truth is this: Middle Eastern power is shifting from ownership of territory toward control of circulation. The decisive weapons will be the systems that keep routes open and the cheap attacks that make those systems unaffordable. Food crises do not begin or end at national borders. COVID-19, conflict, climate and economic shocks and disruptions to energy, fertiliser and trade have shown how quickly pressure in one part of the world can spread through food systems and reach communities thousands of miles away. At the #HLPF in New York, @IFAD hosted a High-Level Roundtable on a difficult but necessary question: How do we finance agrifood systems that can better withstand the next shock? The discussion confirmed that this is no longer only an agricultural issue. Food-system resilience is inseparable from economic security, geopolitical stability and international cooperation. Shocks are transmitted through energy, fertiliser, trade and food markets. In many African countries, for example, more than 80% of fertiliser is imported. Disruption or price volatility in global markets can therefore quickly affect planting decisions, harvests and rural incomes. Small-scale producers and rural entrepreneurs feel these pressures first. Rising input costs and reduced access to finance determine whether they can plant, invest, hire workers or take produce to market. But vulnerability can be reduced. Better fertiliser application and combining organic and inorganic inputs can cut fertiliser use by 25–30% while sustaining or increasing yields. What happens at the #FirstMile shapes food availability, prices, and rural incomes. If disruptions persist, as many as 45 million additional people could face acute food insecurity. Resilience must be financed before the next crisis arrives. That investment must begin at the first mile. Lord Fatafehi Fakafānua, Prime Minister of Tonga, underlined this and brought in the perspective of countries already facing climate and economic vulnerability. Through #IFAD14, we can bring governments, development finance institutions, the private sector and other partners around a shared agenda: addressing immediate food-security pressures while building stronger rural economies and more resilient agrifood systems. @GovIE | @ItalyMFA_int | @ItalyMFA | @MFAEthiopia | @PolandMFA | @PremierRP | @RockefellerFdn #FinancingTheFirstMile
